title: 计算机科学，从零搭建 · 第52部分：用实数计算

chapters.Frontier: 15. 前沿：随机化与低精度的数值计算
chapters.Outro: 回顾、习题，以及它们会在哪里再出现

82371c235a41.en: In the year 2000 a journal asked two numerical analysts to name the ten algorithms that had done most to shape science and engineering in the twentieth century. <bookmark mark='a'/> Their list runs from the Monte Carlo method, born at Los Alamos in 1946, through the simplex method, Krylov iterations, matrix decompositions, the first optimizing compiler, the QR algorithm, Quicksort, the fast Fourier transform, integer relation detection and the fast multipole method. <bookmark mark='b'/> Eight of the ten compute with real numbers. This part is about them, and about the question that hangs over every one: when every operation rounds, which answers can we trust?
82371c235a41.zh: 2000年，一家期刊请两位数值分析学家，评选出二十世纪对科学和工程影响最大的十个算法。<bookmark mark='a'/>他们的名单从1946年诞生于洛斯阿拉莫斯的蒙特卡洛方法开始，经过单纯形法、Krylov 迭代、矩阵分解、第一个优化编译器、QR 算法、快速排序、快速傅里叶变换、整数关系探测，一直到快速多极子方法。<bookmark mark='b'/>这十个算法中，有八个是用实数计算的。这一部分讲的就是它们，以及笼罩在每一个算法之上的那个问题：每一次运算都有舍入，哪些答案可以信任？

d2a2c85b40ff.en: Here is the question in miniature. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two equations in two unknowns. The answer is almost exactly one and one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Gaussian elimination, done the way it is taught in school, in double precision, answers that the first unknown is zero. Every digit is wrong. <bookmark mark='c'/> Swap the two equations before eliminating, and the same arithmetic gets it right. <bookmark mark='d'/> Nothing about the problem is difficult. A tiny change in the data changes the answer only a little. The algorithm was the problem. Separating the difficulty of a problem from the quality of an algorithm is the first idea of numerical analysis, and the rest of the part is built on it.
d2a2c85b40ff.zh: 这是这个问题的一个缩影。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个方程，两个未知数。答案几乎恰好是1和1。<bookmark mark='b'/>按学校里教的方式做高斯消去，用双精度，得到的答案是第一个未知数等于0。每一位数字都是错的。<bookmark mark='c'/>在消去之前把两个方程交换一下，同样的算术就能算对。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个问题本身没有任何困难。数据的微小变化，只让答案改变一点点。出问题的是算法。把问题的难度与算法的好坏区分开来，是数值分析的第一个思想，这一部分其余的内容都建立在它之上。

b4a831c17ad7.en: This is Part 52 of Computer Science, Built, and it opens where Part 4 left off, with numbers that round. <bookmark mark='a'/> We will separate a problem's conditioning from an algorithm's stability; solve linear systems by elimination, QR and the SVD; find eigenvalues by an iteration that converges cubically; solve a million equations with conjugate gradients and multigrid; follow Newton's method into its fractal; interpolate, integrate, and step through stiff equations; and see why the fastest code on every machine is matrix multiplication.
b4a831c17ad7.zh: 这是计算机科学，从零搭建，第52部分，它从第4部分停下的地方开始，也就是会舍入的数。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们将把问题的条件与算法的稳定性区分开来；用消去法、QR 和 SVD 求解线性方程组；用一种三次收敛的迭代求特征值；用共轭梯度法和多重网格求解一百万个方程；跟着牛顿法走进它的分形；做插值、做积分，并一步一步地求解刚性方程；还要看看为什么在每一台机器上，最快的代码都是矩阵乘法。

02b789b07430.en: Before asking whether an algorithm is good, ask whether the problem is hard. <bookmark mark='a'/> Nudge the data x by a small relative amount. The answer moves too, and the ratio of the two relative changes is the problem's condition number, kappa. <bookmark mark='b'/> Write the change in f as f at x plus delta x, minus f at x, and regroup: a difference quotient, times x over f of x. <bookmark mark='c'/> As the nudge shrinks, the quotient becomes the derivative. Kappa is the size of x times f prime of x, over f of x. <bookmark mark='d'/> Notice what is missing: no algorithm, no rounding. Kappa belongs to the problem alone, and a problem with a large kappa is called ill conditioned.
02b789b07430.zh: 在问一个算法好不好之前，先问这个问题难不难。<bookmark mark='a'/>把数据 x 推动一个小的相对量。答案也会移动，这两个相对变化之比，就是这个问题的条件数 κ。<bookmark mark='b'/>把 f 的变化写成 f 在 x 加 δx 处的值减去 f 在 x 处的值，再重新组合：一个差商，乘以 x 除以 f(x)。<bookmark mark='c'/>当推动越来越小，这个差商就变成导数。κ 等于 x 乘以 f 撇 x 的大小，除以 f(x)。<bookmark mark='d'/>注意少了什么：没有算法，也没有舍入。κ 只属于问题本身，而 κ 很大的问题叫作病态的。

7a552dc65393.en: Four small problems show the range. <bookmark mark='a'/> Subtracting one from a number very close to one: kappa is x over x minus one, about a million. That is Part 4's cancellation, and now we see it is the problem's fault, not the computer's. <bookmark mark='b'/> The square root has kappa one half everywhere: it halves relative errors. <bookmark mark='c'/> The exponential has kappa equal to x, so at x equal to one hundred, kappa is a hundred. <bookmark mark='d'/> The tangent, close to a right angle, has kappa about sixteen thousand. <bookmark mark='e'/> The rule of thumb: from data good to sixteen digits, expect about sixteen, minus the logarithm of kappa to base ten.
7a552dc65393.zh: 四个小问题展示了它的范围。<bookmark mark='a'/>从一个非常接近1的数里减去1：κ 等于 x 除以 x 减1，大约100万。这就是第4部分的抵消，而现在我们看到，这是问题的错，不是计算机的错。<bookmark mark='b'/>平方根的 κ 处处都是二分之一：它把相对误差减半。<bookmark mark='c'/>指数函数的 κ 等于 x，所以在 x 等于100处，κ 就是100。<bookmark mark='d'/>正切函数在接近直角的地方，κ 大约是16000。<bookmark mark='e'/>经验法则是：数据有16位精确数字，就大约能得到16减去 κ 的常用对数那么多位。

b0b40525d352.en: For a linear system A x equals b, perturb the right-hand side. <bookmark mark='a'/> Subtract the two equations: A times delta x equals delta b. <bookmark mark='b'/> So delta x is A inverse times delta b, and its size is at most the norm of A inverse times the size of delta b. <bookmark mark='c'/> Since b is A x, x is at least as large as b over the norm of A. Divide: the relative change in x is at most the norm of A, times the norm of A inverse, times the relative change in b. <bookmark mark='d'/> That product is the matrix's condition number, a name Alan Turing gave it in 1948. <bookmark mark='e'/> Geometrically, A turns the unit circle into an ellipse, and kappa is its longest axis over its shortest.
b0b40525d352.zh: 对线性方程组 A x 等于 b，扰动它的右端项。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个方程相减：A 乘 δx 等于 δb。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以 δx 等于 A 的逆乘以 δb，它的大小至多是 A 的逆的范数乘以 δb 的大小。<bookmark mark='c'/>因为 b 等于 A x，所以 x 至少有 b 除以 A 的范数那么大。两式相除：x 的相对变化，至多是 A 的范数，乘以 A 的逆的范数，再乘以 b 的相对变化。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个乘积就是矩阵的条件数，这个名字是阿兰·图灵在1948年取的。<bookmark mark='e'/>从几何上看，A 把单位圆变成一个椭圆，而 κ 就是它的最长轴与最短轴之比。

1412e59fbc9f.en: Some problems are ill conditioned through and through. <bookmark mark='a'/> David Hilbert's matrix has entries one over i plus j minus one. It arises when fitting polynomials by least squares, and its neighbouring columns are so nearly parallel that the system barely determines x. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our instrument measures its condition number: about sixteen thousand for size four, fifteen billion for size eight, <bookmark mark='c'/> and for size twelve, one point six times ten to the sixteen, past one over machine epsilon. <bookmark mark='d'/> By the rule of thumb, twelve digits survive at size four, six at size eight, and none at size twelve, whatever algorithm we use.
1412e59fbc9f.zh: 有些问题从里到外都是病态的。<bookmark mark='a'/>大卫·希尔伯特的矩阵，元素是 i 加 j 减1分之一。用最小二乘拟合多项式时就会出现它，它相邻的列几乎平行，以至于这个方程组几乎确定不了 x。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的仪器测量了它的条件数：4阶时约为16000，8阶时为150亿，<bookmark mark='c'/>而12阶时是1.6乘以10的16次方，超过了机器精度的倒数。<bookmark mark='d'/>按照经验法则，无论用什么算法，4阶时剩下12位数字，8阶时剩下6位，12阶时一位也不剩。

d6d4823183c3.en: Conditioning is the problem's share of the error. Stability is the algorithm's. <bookmark mark='a'/> The exact map f takes data x to the answer f of x. The algorithm, f tilde, rounds at every step and lands somewhere else. <bookmark mark='b'/> James Wilkinson's question was: is there nearby data, x tilde, for which that wrong answer is exactly right? If there always is, within a small multiple of machine epsilon, the algorithm is called backward stable. <bookmark mark='c'/> A backward stable algorithm commits no more error than rounding the data once would, and conditioning turns that into the answer's error. The hook's two equations were well conditioned; elimination without row swaps was simply unstable.
d6d4823183c3.zh: 条件是误差中属于问题的那一份，稳定性是属于算法的那一份。<bookmark mark='a'/>精确映射 f 把数据 x 送到答案 f(x)。算法 f 波浪在每一步都舍入，落到了别的地方。<bookmark mark='b'/>詹姆斯·威尔金森的问题是：是否存在邻近的数据 x 波浪，使得那个错误的答案恰好是对的？如果总是存在，而且相差在机器精度的一个小倍数之内，这个算法就叫作向后稳定的。<bookmark mark='c'/>向后稳定的算法所犯的误差，不超过把数据舍入一次所带来的误差，而条件数把它转化为答案的误差。开场的那两个方程是良态的；不做行交换的消去法，只不过是不稳定而已。

f98db09fc95a.en: James Wilkinson learned his trade beside Turing at the National Physical Laboratory, and he analysed rounding with one simple model. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every floating-point operation returns the exact result times one plus delta, where delta is at most the unit roundoff, about ten to the minus sixteen in double precision. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add three numbers. Each addition rounds once. <bookmark mark='c'/> Multiply it out, and each input picks up its own small factor. <bookmark mark='d'/> So the computed sum is the exact sum of slightly different numbers, each changed by about two roundings. That is a backward error: not how wrong the answer is, but how far the data must move to make it exactly right.
f98db09fc95a.zh: 詹姆斯·威尔金森是在英国国家物理实验室，在图灵身边学会这门手艺的，他用一个简单的模型来分析舍入。<bookmark mark='a'/>每一次浮点运算返回的，都是精确结果乘以一加 δ，其中 δ 至多是单位舍入误差，在双精度下大约是10的负16次方。<bookmark mark='b'/>把三个数加起来。每一次加法舍入一次。<bookmark mark='c'/>把它乘开，每个输入都得到它自己的一个小因子。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以计算出的和，是几个略有不同的数的精确和，每个数大约被改变了两次舍入。这就是向后误差：不是答案错了多少，而是数据必须移动多远，才能让答案恰好正确。

345a686901e7.en: Why ask the question backwards? Because the two errors are tied together by the condition number. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose the computed answer, y hat, is the exact answer for data x plus delta x. <bookmark mark='b'/> To first order, the answer moves by f prime of x times delta x. <bookmark mark='c'/> Divide by y, and multiply and divide by x: the relative forward error is kappa times the relative backward error. <bookmark mark='d'/> Forward error is at most the condition number times the backward error. The algorithm controls one factor and the problem the other, and each can be studied on its own.
345a686901e7.zh: 为什么要倒过来问这个问题？因为这两种误差由条件数联系在一起。<bookmark mark='a'/>假设计算出的答案 y 帽，是数据 x 加 δx 的精确答案。<bookmark mark='b'/>在一阶近似下，答案移动了 f 撇 x 乘以 δx。<bookmark mark='c'/>除以 y，再同乘同除以 x：相对向前误差等于 κ 乘以相对向后误差。<bookmark mark='d'/>向前误差至多是条件数乘以向后误差。算法控制其中一个因子，问题控制另一个，而每一个都可以单独研究。

027d4581301d.en: For linear systems the rule is exact, and the backward error can be measured. <bookmark mark='a'/> Given a computed solution x hat, form the residual: b minus A x hat. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add to A the rank-one matrix r times x hat transposed, over the size of x hat squared, and x hat solves the changed system exactly. <bookmark mark='c'/> That change, relative to A, has size the norm of r over the norm of A times the norm of x hat. Call it eta: it is computed after the fact, from things we have. <bookmark mark='d'/> Meanwhile the true error, x minus x hat, is A inverse times r. <bookmark mark='e'/> Take norms, and the relative error is at most kappa times eta, with no approximation at all.
027d4581301d.zh: 对线性方程组，这条规则是精确的，而且向后误差可以测量。<bookmark mark='a'/>给定一个计算出的解 x 帽，构造残差：b 减 A x 帽。<bookmark mark='b'/>给 A 加上一个秩一矩阵，r 乘以 x 帽的转置，再除以 x 帽大小的平方，这样 x 帽就恰好是改变后的方程组的解。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个改变相对于 A 的大小，是 r 的范数除以 A 的范数与 x 帽的范数之积。把它叫作 η：它是事后算出来的，用的都是我们手头已有的东西。<bookmark mark='d'/>与此同时，真正的误差，x 减 x 帽，等于 A 的逆乘以 r。<bookmark mark='e'/>取范数，相对误差就至多是 κ 乘以 η，完全没有近似。

96babc90d976.en: Our instrument tests the rule on Hilbert systems. It picks x, sets b to H times x, and solves with LAPACK's pivoted elimination, through NumPy. <bookmark mark='a'/> The backward error stays near ten to the minus seventeen at every size: the algorithm is as stable as rounding allows. <bookmark mark='b'/> The forward error climbs from two times ten to the minus thirteen at size four to about five percent at size twelve. <bookmark mark='c'/> And at every size it stays below kappa times eta, the bound we derived. Nothing went wrong inside the algorithm; the problem amplified the rounding of its own data.
96babc90d976.zh: 我们的仪器在希尔伯特方程组上检验这条规则。它选定 x，令 b 等于 H 乘 x，再通过 NumPy，用 LAPACK 的选主元消去法求解。<bookmark mark='a'/>向后误差在每个阶数上都保持在10的负17次方附近：这个算法稳定到了舍入所允许的极限。<bookmark mark='b'/>向前误差则从4阶时的2乘以10的负13次方，攀升到12阶时的约百分之五。<bookmark mark='c'/>而且在每个阶数上，它都低于 κ 乘以 η，也就是我们推导出的界。算法内部没有出任何错；是问题放大了它自己数据的舍入。

ffed80f5563a.en: In digits, the picture is simple. <bookmark mark='a'/> At size four, twelve of the sixteen digits are right. <bookmark mark='b'/> At size eight, seven. <bookmark mark='c'/> At size twelve, one. <bookmark mark='d'/> Each time, the digits lost are about the logarithm of kappa: a backward stable algorithm loses only what the problem itself destroys. <bookmark mark='e'/> This was Wilkinson's great clarification, set out in his 1963 book, Rounding Errors in Algebraic Processes, and it earned him the Turing Award in 1970. The next chapter applies it to the most used algorithm of all, Gaussian elimination.
ffed80f5563a.zh: 用位数来说，图景很简单。<bookmark mark='a'/>4阶时，16位数字里有12位是对的。<bookmark mark='b'/>8阶时，7位。<bookmark mark='c'/>12阶时，1位。<bookmark mark='d'/>每一次，丢掉的位数大约就是 κ 的对数：向后稳定的算法，只丢掉问题本身毁掉的那些。<bookmark mark='e'/>这是威尔金森伟大的澄清，写在他1963年的书《代数过程中的舍入误差》（Rounding Errors in Algebraic Processes）里，并让他在1970年获得了图灵奖。下一章把它用在所有算法中用得最多的那一个上：高斯消去法。

283ec7107130.en: Elimination is the oldest algorithm in this part: the Chinese Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art already use it. <bookmark mark='a'/> To clear the first column below the pivot, subtract two times row one from row two, and four times row one from row three. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then three times the new row two from row three. What remains is upper triangular: call it U. <bookmark mark='c'/> Keep the multipliers, two, four and three, in a lower triangular matrix with ones on its diagonal: call it L. <bookmark mark='d'/> Then A equals L times U, as Turing pointed out in 1948. Solving A x equals b is then two triangular solves: L from the top down, then U from the bottom up.
283ec7107130.zh: 消去法是这一部分里最古老的算法：中国的《九章算术》就已经用到了它。<bookmark mark='a'/>为了把主元下方的第一列清零，从第二行减去第一行的2倍，从第三行减去第一行的4倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>再从第三行减去新的第二行的3倍。剩下的是上三角的：把它叫作 U。<bookmark mark='c'/>把乘数2、4和3保存在一个对角线全是1的下三角矩阵里：把它叫作 L。<bookmark mark='d'/>于是 A 等于 L 乘 U，这是图灵在1948年指出的。这样，求解 A x 等于 b 就成了两次三角求解：L 从上往下，然后 U 从下往上。

2aa98e341f52.en: How much work is it? <bookmark mark='a'/> Step k updates the block below and to the right of the pivot: n minus k squared entries, each one multiply and one subtract. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add up the steps, and count from the end. <bookmark mark='c'/> The sum of the first squares is a cubic, <bookmark mark='d'/> and its leading term gives two thirds of n cubed operations. <bookmark mark='e'/> The triangular solves cost only about n squared each, so the factorization is done once and reused for every right-hand side. Computing the inverse instead would cost three times as much, hence the rule: to solve, never invert.
2aa98e341f52.zh: 工作量有多大？<bookmark mark='a'/>第 k 步更新主元右下方的块：n 减 k 的平方个元素，每个做一次乘法和一次减法。<bookmark mark='b'/>把各步加起来，并从末尾开始数。<bookmark mark='c'/>前若干个平方数之和是一个三次式，<bookmark mark='d'/>它的首项给出 n 的立方的三分之二次运算。<bookmark mark='e'/>每次三角求解只花大约 n 的平方，所以分解只做一次，就能对每一个右端项重复使用。改为计算逆矩阵，要花三倍的工作量，于是有了这条规则：要求解，永远不要求逆。

2a1137631b3f.en: Here is the hook's failure. <bookmark mark='a'/> Eliminating with the tiny pivot epsilon needs the multiplier one over epsilon, and leaves one minus one over epsilon in the corner. <bookmark mark='b'/> With epsilon ten to the minus twenty, that rounds to minus ten to the twenty. The one is gone. <bookmark mark='c'/> The computed factors are the exact factors of a different matrix, with a zero where the one was. <bookmark mark='d'/> The cure is partial pivoting: before each step, swap up the row with the largest entry in the column, so every multiplier is at most one. <bookmark mark='e'/> In our instrument's runs, without pivoting the error grows as epsilon shrinks, until no digit is right; with pivoting it stays at the level of rounding.
2a1137631b3f.zh: 这就是开场里的那次失败。<bookmark mark='a'/>用很小的主元 ε 做消去，需要乘数 ε 分之一，并在角上留下1减 ε 分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>当 ε 是10的负20次方时，它舍入成负10的20次方。那个1没了。<bookmark mark='c'/>计算出的因子，是另一个矩阵的精确因子，那个矩阵在原来是1的地方是0。<bookmark mark='d'/>解药是部分选主元：每一步之前，把这一列中元素最大的那一行换上来，这样每个乘数都至多为1。<bookmark mark='e'/>在我们仪器的运行中，不选主元时，误差随着 ε 变小而增大，直到没有一位数字是对的；选主元时，误差始终保持在舍入的水平。

5d774552eba4.en: With pivoting, how large can the entries of U become? <bookmark mark='a'/> Each step replaces an entry by itself minus a multiplier, at most one, times another entry, <bookmark mark='b'/> so the largest entry at most doubles. <bookmark mark='c'/> Over n minus one steps, the growth factor rho is at most two to the n minus one, as Wilkinson proved, and elimination's backward error grows with rho. <bookmark mark='d'/> The bound is attained: here the last column doubles at every step. <bookmark mark='e'/> Measured, it is exactly two to the n minus one on Wilkinson's matrix, nine times ten to the eighteen at size sixty-four, <bookmark mark='f'/> but about four for random matrices of that size. Lloyd Trefethen and Robert Schreiber studied this in 1990: in practice growth is small, and nobody has proved why.
5d774552eba4.zh: 选主元之后，U 的元素能变得多大？<bookmark mark='a'/>每一步把一个元素替换成它自身减去一个至多为1的乘数乘以另一个元素，<bookmark mark='b'/>所以最大的元素至多翻一倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>经过 n 减1步，增长因子 ρ 至多是2的 n 减1次方，这是威尔金森证明的，而消去法的向后误差随 ρ 增长。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个界是能达到的：这里最后一列每一步都翻倍。<bookmark mark='e'/>实测下来，在威尔金森的矩阵上它恰好是2的 n 减1次方，64阶时是9乘以10的18次方，<bookmark mark='f'/>但对同样大小的随机矩阵，只有大约4。Lloyd Trefethen 和 Robert Schreiber 在1990年研究过这个问题：实践中增长很小，而没有人证明过这是为什么。

1c07817ec550.en: When A is symmetric and positive definite, as covariance matrices are, elimination can be halved. <bookmark mark='a'/> Write A as L times L transposed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Match the entries: l one one squared is a, l one one times l two one is b, and the corner gives c. <bookmark mark='c'/> Solve in order: square roots and a division. Positive definiteness is exactly the condition that every square root is of a positive number. Each entry of L is bounded by the square root of a diagonal entry of A, so nothing can grow, and no pivoting is needed. <bookmark mark='d'/> André-Louis Cholesky's method costs a third of n cubed operations, half of LU.
1c07817ec550.zh: 当 A 是对称正定的，就像协方差矩阵那样，消去法的工作量可以减半。<bookmark mark='a'/>把 A 写成 L 乘 L 的转置。<bookmark mark='b'/>对应元素：l 一一的平方等于 a，l 一一乘 l 二一等于 b，而角上给出 c。<bookmark mark='c'/>依次求解：几个平方根和一次除法。正定性恰好就是每个平方根下都是正数的条件。L 的每个元素都以 A 的某个对角元的平方根为界，所以什么都不会增长，也不需要选主元。<bookmark mark='d'/>André-Louis Cholesky 的方法需要 n 的立方的三分之一次运算，是 LU 的一半。

6e2d84828242.en: Chapter four. Least squares and QR.
6e2d84828242.zh: 第四章：最小二乘与 QR。

7ab7076307a9.en: Least squares, published by Adrien-Marie Legendre in 1805 and claimed by Gauss, fits a model with more equations than unknowns. <bookmark mark='a'/> We want the x that brings A x as close as possible to b. <bookmark mark='b'/> The closest A x is the foot of the perpendicular from b to the plane spanned by A's columns, so the residual is orthogonal to every column: A transposed times the residual is zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> Rearranged, these are the normal equations, a small square system. <bookmark mark='d'/> But A transposed A has the squares of A's singular values, so its condition number is kappa squared. A problem with kappa a million becomes one with kappa a trillion.
7ab7076307a9.zh: 最小二乘法由 Adrien-Marie Legendre 在1805年发表，高斯也宣称是自己的发现；它用方程比未知数多的方程组来拟合一个模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们想要的 x，要让 A x 尽可能接近 b。<bookmark mark='b'/>最接近的 A x，是从 b 向 A 的各列张成的平面所作垂线的垂足，所以残差与每一列都正交：A 的转置乘以残差等于零。<bookmark mark='c'/>整理一下，这就是正规方程，一个小的方阵方程组。<bookmark mark='d'/>但 A 转置 A 的奇异值是 A 的奇异值的平方，所以它的条件数是 κ 的平方。一个 κ 为一百万的问题，变成了 κ 为一万亿的问题。

edca0aeadabc.en: Gene Golub's answer, in 1965, was never to form A transposed A at all. <bookmark mark='a'/> Factor A as an orthogonal matrix Q times an upper triangular R. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiplying by Q transposed changes no lengths, so the size of the residual is unchanged, and the problem splits in two. <bookmark mark='c'/> The bottom rows are what no x can fix; the top rows are a triangular system whose condition number is kappa, not kappa squared. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our instrument fits a tall system at four condition numbers. The normal equations' error grows like kappa squared, reaching thirty-seven percent at kappa ten to the eight. <bookmark mark='e'/> The QR solution's error grows only like kappa.
edca0aeadabc.zh: Gene Golub 在1965年给出的答案是：根本不要构造 A 转置 A。<bookmark mark='a'/>把 A 分解成一个正交矩阵 Q 乘以一个上三角矩阵 R。<bookmark mark='b'/>乘以 Q 的转置不改变任何长度，所以残差的大小不变，而问题一分为二。<bookmark mark='c'/>下面几行是任何 x 都修正不了的部分；上面几行是一个三角方程组，它的条件数是 κ，而不是 κ 的平方。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的仪器在四个条件数下拟合一个高瘦的方程组。正规方程的误差像 κ 的平方那样增长，在 κ 为10的8次方时达到百分之三十七。<bookmark mark='e'/>QR 解的误差只像 κ 那样增长。

aa91ef8a20c3.en: How do we find Q and R stably? Alston Householder's answer, in 1958, was mirrors. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take the first column, x, here three and four. We want a reflection that lays it on the first axis. Reflections keep lengths, so it must land at plus or minus five. <bookmark mark='b'/> The mirror is perpendicular to v, which points along x plus five times e one. Reflecting subtracts twice the component along v, <bookmark mark='c'/> and x lands exactly at minus five, zero. Choosing the sign this way adds two positive numbers instead of subtracting nearly equal ones: chapter one's cancellation, avoided. <bookmark mark='d'/> The same mirror carries the second column to minus three, one, and the matrix is triangular. <bookmark mark='e'/> A bigger matrix needs one mirror per column, each zeroing everything below the diagonal, and Q is their product.
aa91ef8a20c3.zh: 怎样稳定地求出 Q 和 R？Alston Householder 在1958年给出的答案是：镜子。<bookmark mark='a'/>取第一列 x，这里是3和4。我们想要一个反射，把它放倒到第一个坐标轴上。反射保持长度，所以它必须落在正5或负5。<bookmark mark='b'/>镜面垂直于 v，而 v 沿着 x 加5倍 e1 的方向。反射就是减去沿 v 方向分量的两倍，<bookmark mark='c'/>于是 x 恰好落在负5、0。这样选符号，是把两个正数相加，而不是把两个几乎相等的数相减：第一章的抵消，就这样避免了。<bookmark mark='d'/>同一面镜子把第二列送到负3、1，矩阵就成了三角的。<bookmark mark='e'/>更大的矩阵每一列需要一面镜子，每面镜子都把对角线以下的一切清零，而 Q 就是它们的乘积。

739fee561f15.en: Wallace Givens used rotations instead of mirrors. <bookmark mark='a'/> Rotate the pair a, b, here three and four, by the angle that lays it on the axis. <bookmark mark='b'/> The cosine is a over r and the sine b over r, where r is the length. <bookmark mark='c'/> Check: the second entry becomes minus a b plus a b, which is zero, and the first becomes r, here five. <bookmark mark='d'/> Each rotation touches only two rows and zeroes one entry. Our three by three example needs only two, because one entry starts at zero. <bookmark mark='e'/> That economy is why the eigenvalue algorithm of chapter six applies rotations to its nearly triangular matrices.
739fee561f15.zh: Wallace Givens 用旋转代替了镜子。<bookmark mark='a'/>把数对 a、b，这里是3和4，旋转一个角度，让它落到坐标轴上。<bookmark mark='b'/>余弦是 a 除以 r，正弦是 b 除以 r，其中 r 是长度。<bookmark mark='c'/>验算一下：第二个元素变成负 a b 加 a b，也就是零，第一个元素变成 r，这里是5。<bookmark mark='d'/>每次旋转只涉及两行，并把一个元素清零。我们的三乘三例子只需要两次旋转，因为有一个元素一开始就是零。<bookmark mark='e'/>正是这种节省，让第六章的特征值算法在它那些近乎三角的矩阵上使用旋转。

d56387332a27.en: The textbook way to get Q is Gram–Schmidt: take each column and subtract its components along the columns before it. <bookmark mark='a'/> Classical Gram–Schmidt measures each component against the original column. <bookmark mark='b'/> Modified Gram–Schmidt measures it against the column as updated so far. In exact arithmetic they are the same algorithm. <bookmark mark='c'/> In floating point, on Hilbert matrices, the classical version's Q is not orthogonal at all by size eight. <bookmark mark='d'/> The modified one loses orthogonality in proportion to kappa, as Åke Björck proved in 1967. <bookmark mark='e'/> Householder's mirrors stay orthogonal to machine precision at every size, because every mirror is exactly orthogonal by construction.
d56387332a27.zh: 求 Q 的教科书方法是 Gram–Schmidt 正交化：取每一列，减去它沿前面各列的分量。<bookmark mark='a'/>经典 Gram–Schmidt 用原始的列来度量每个分量。<bookmark mark='b'/>修正 Gram–Schmidt 用到目前为止已经更新过的列来度量。在精确算术下，它们是同一个算法。<bookmark mark='c'/>在浮点数下，对希尔伯特矩阵，经典版本得到的 Q 到8阶时已经完全不正交了。<bookmark mark='d'/>修正版本丧失的正交性与 κ 成正比，这是 Åke Björck 在1967年证明的。<bookmark mark='e'/>Householder 的镜子在每个阶数上都保持正交到机器精度，因为每面镜子在构造上就是精确正交的。

dbc7ad85bef6.en: Chapter five. The singular value decomposition.

e9120e72c441.en: Every matrix, of any shape, has a singular value decomposition. <bookmark mark='a'/> Watch this two by two matrix act on the unit circle. First a rotation, V transposed, turns two special perpendicular directions onto the axes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then a diagonal matrix, sigma, stretches each axis by a singular value. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then a second rotation, U, and the circle is an ellipse. <bookmark mark='d'/> In symbols, A sends each right singular vector v i to sigma i times u i. Side by side as columns, and since V is orthogonal, A equals U sigma V transposed. <bookmark mark='e'/> The longest stretch over the shortest is chapter one's condition number.
e9120e72c441.zh: 每个矩阵，无论什么形状，都有奇异值分解。<bookmark mark='a'/>看这个二乘二矩阵作用在单位圆上。先是一个旋转 V 转置，把两个特殊的、互相垂直的方向转到坐标轴上。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后一个对角矩阵 Σ，把每个坐标轴按一个奇异值拉伸。<bookmark mark='c'/>再是第二个旋转 U，圆就成了一个椭圆。<bookmark mark='d'/>用符号来写，A 把每个右奇异向量 v i 送到 σ i 乘以 u i。把它们作为列并排放在一起，又因为 V 是正交的，A 就等于 U Σ V 转置。<bookmark mark='e'/>最长的拉伸除以最短的拉伸，就是第一章的条件数。

f6d61fb072ac.en: Multiply the decomposition out and a matrix becomes a sum of rank-one pieces, largest first. <bookmark mark='a'/> Keep the first k, and you have the best rank k approximation there is: Carl Eckart and Gale Young proved in 1936 that its error is the next singular value, the fact behind the embeddings of AI, Built, Part 3. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here are the eighty singular values of a matrix that blurs a signal. <bookmark mark='c'/> Below the rounding level they are noise in the arithmetic, so the numerical rank is 56, not eighty. <bookmark mark='d'/> And below the noise in our data, one part in a thousand, only 25 carry information. In floating point, rank depends on a tolerance.
f6d61fb072ac.zh: 把这个分解乘开，一个矩阵就变成若干个秩一部分之和，最大的在前。<bookmark mark='a'/>保留前 k 个，就得到了所有秩 k 近似中最好的那一个：Carl Eckart 和 Gale Young 在1936年证明，它的误差就是下一个奇异值，这一事实正是《人工智能，从零搭建》第3部分里那些嵌入背后的道理。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里是一个模糊信号的矩阵的80个奇异值。<bookmark mark='c'/>低于舍入水平的那些，是算术中的噪声，所以数值秩是56，而不是80。<bookmark mark='d'/>而以我们数据中的噪声，也就是千分之一来衡量，只有25个携带信息。在浮点数中，秩取决于一个容差。

5399d62a103e.en: Here is the experiment. <bookmark mark='a'/> A signal of two boxes, in green, is blurred by that matrix, and noise of one part in a thousand is added: the yellow curve. Can we undo the blur? <bookmark mark='b'/> Invert each factor of the decomposition, and the solution is a sum with one term per singular value, each coefficient divided by its sigma. <bookmark mark='c'/> But the noise is divided by the singular values too, and the smallest is ten to the minus sixteen. <bookmark mark='d'/> The condition number is about ten to the sixteen, and the naive solution's error is ten to the thirteen times the signal. The arithmetic is not at fault: the problem, as posed, cannot be solved.
5399d62a103e.zh: 这是那个实验。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个由两个方块组成的信号，绿色的，被那个矩阵模糊，再加上千分之一的噪声：就是这条黄色曲线。我们能撤销这次模糊吗？<bookmark mark='b'/>把分解的每个因子求逆，解就成了一个和，每个奇异值对应一项，每个系数都除以它的 σ。<bookmark mark='c'/>但噪声也被奇异值除，而最小的奇异值是10的负16次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>条件数大约是10的16次方，朴素解的误差是信号的10的13次方倍。错不在算术：这个问题，照它提出的样子，是解不了的。

98b89e73dc12.en: The cure is to stop dividing by tiny numbers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Keep only the first k terms: the truncated SVD. Each term dropped loses a little signal; each term kept adds noise divided by its sigma. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our instrument tries every k. The error falls from 77 percent with one term to 19 percent at k equals 23, then explodes, back to ten to the thirteen with all eighty. <bookmark mark='c'/> At the best k the two boxes come back, a little rounded. <bookmark mark='d'/> Andrey Tikhonov's regularization, from 1963, damps each term smoothly instead of cutting it off. Either way, we deliberately solve a nearby, well-conditioned problem.
98b89e73dc12.zh: 解药是不再除以极小的数。<bookmark mark='a'/>只保留前 k 项：截断 SVD。每丢掉一项，就丢失一点信号；每保留一项，就加入被它的 σ 除过的噪声。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的仪器尝试了每一个 k。误差从只有一项时的百分之77，降到 k 等于23时的百分之19，然后爆炸，到全部80项时又回到10的13次方。<bookmark mark='c'/>在最好的 k 处，两个方块回来了，只是稍微圆了一点。<bookmark mark='d'/>Andrey Tikhonov 1963年的正则化，平滑地衰减每一项，而不是把它截掉。无论哪种方式，我们都是有意去解一个邻近的、良态的问题。

e6efc1d7dc91.en: How is it computed? Not from A transposed A, which would square the condition number again. <bookmark mark='a'/> Gene Golub and William Kahan, in 1965, applied Householder mirrors alternately from the left and the right, clearing a column, then a row. <bookmark mark='b'/> What is left is bidiagonal, with the same singular values, and a variant of the next chapter's QR algorithm finds them. <bookmark mark='c'/> The payoff is the pseudo-inverse: invert only the singular values above a tolerance, and you get the shortest least-squares solution even when the matrix is rank deficient. <bookmark mark='d'/> The SVD costs several times as much as QR, so it is the tool of last resort: when other methods fail, it says exactly how much the data can tell you.
e6efc1d7dc91.zh: 它是怎么计算的？不是通过 A 转置 A，那样又会把条件数平方。<bookmark mark='a'/>Gene Golub 和威廉·卡亨在1965年，交替地从左边和右边施加 Householder 镜子，清掉一列，再清掉一行。<bookmark mark='b'/>剩下的是一个双对角矩阵，奇异值不变，再由下一章 QR 算法的一个变体把它们求出来。<bookmark mark='c'/>回报是伪逆：只对高于某个容差的奇异值求逆，即使矩阵是秩亏损的，也能得到最短的最小二乘解。<bookmark mark='d'/>SVD 的代价是 QR 的好几倍，所以它是最后的手段：当其他方法都失败时，它能确切地告诉你，数据能告诉你多少。

21c9722a2783.en: Chapter six. Eigenvalues, and the QR algorithm.
21c9722a2783.zh: 第六章：特征值，以及 QR 算法。

4f5356d6005b.en: An eigenvector is a direction that a matrix only stretches: A v equals lambda v. <bookmark mark='a'/> Move everything to one side. A minus lambda I sends v to zero, so it is singular, and its determinant vanishes. <bookmark mark='b'/> That determinant is a polynomial of degree n, and the eigenvalues are its roots: here, the eight roots for a random symmetric eight by eight matrix. <bookmark mark='c'/> Niels Henrik Abel proved in 1824 that no formula in radicals solves the general polynomial of degree five. <bookmark mark='d'/> And every polynomial is the characteristic polynomial of some matrix, its companion matrix. So no finite recipe finds eigenvalues in general: every eigenvalue algorithm must iterate.
4f5356d6005b.zh: 特征向量是矩阵只拉伸、不转动的方向：A v 等于 λ v。<bookmark mark='a'/>把所有项移到一边。A 减 λI 把 v 送到零，所以它是奇异的，它的行列式为零。<bookmark mark='b'/>这个行列式是一个 n 次多项式，特征值就是它的根：这里是一个随机的八乘八对称矩阵的八个根。<bookmark mark='c'/>Niels Henrik Abel 在1824年证明，一般的五次多项式没有根式求解公式。<bookmark mark='d'/>而每个多项式都是某个矩阵的特征多项式，也就是它的友矩阵。所以一般来说，没有任何有限的步骤能求出特征值：每一个特征值算法都必须迭代。

0ca9b1819a26.en: The simplest iteration is the power method. <bookmark mark='a'/> Write a starting vector in terms of the eigenvectors. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiplying by A k times multiplies each component by its eigenvalue to the k. <bookmark mark='c'/> Factor out the largest: every other component shrinks like a ratio to the k. Here the ratio is about two thirds, and the error reaches ten to the minus thirteen after 36 steps. <bookmark mark='d'/> Inverse iteration uses the inverse of A minus a shift, mu, whose eigenvalues are one over lambda minus mu, so the eigenvalue nearest the shift dominates overwhelmingly. With a shift nought point three away, 8 steps suffice, each a linear solve with chapter three's factors.
0ca9b1819a26.zh: 最简单的迭代是幂法。<bookmark mark='a'/>把一个起始向量用特征向量表示出来。<bookmark mark='b'/>乘以 A 共 k 次，就把每个分量乘以它的特征值的 k 次方。<bookmark mark='c'/>把最大的那个提出来：其他每个分量都像一个比值的 k 次方那样缩小。这里的比值大约是三分之二，误差在36步之后达到10的负13次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>逆迭代用的是 A 减去一个位移 μ 之后的逆，它的特征值是 λ 减 μ 分之一，所以离位移最近的那个特征值压倒性地占主导。位移相差0.3时，8步就够了，每一步都是用第三章的因子做一次线性求解。

8d253389d602.en: In 1961 John Francis in England and, independently, Vera Kublanovskaya in the Soviet Union found the algorithm still used today. <bookmark mark='a'/> Factor the matrix as Q times R. <bookmark mark='b'/> Since Q is orthogonal, R is Q transposed A. <bookmark mark='c'/> Now multiply the factors in the other order. <bookmark mark='d'/> The result is Q transposed A Q, a similarity, so the eigenvalues are unchanged: it is the power method applied to a whole basis at once. <bookmark mark='e'/> Repeat, and the matrix creeps towards diagonal form, the eigenvalues appearing on its diagonal. Coloured by size on a log scale, our matrix's last off-diagonal entry fades to ten to the minus fifteen in forty iterations. Finishing all eight takes 623.
8d253389d602.zh: 1961年，英格兰的 John Francis，以及苏联的 Vera Kublanovskaya，各自独立地找到了今天仍在使用的算法。<bookmark mark='a'/>把矩阵分解成 Q 乘 R。<bookmark mark='b'/>因为 Q 是正交的，R 就等于 Q 转置乘 A。<bookmark mark='c'/>现在把两个因子按相反的次序相乘。<bookmark mark='d'/>结果是 Q 转置 A Q，一个相似变换，所以特征值不变：这就是把幂法一次作用在一整组基上。<bookmark mark='e'/>重复下去，矩阵就慢慢趋向对角形式，特征值出现在它的对角线上。按大小在对数刻度上着色，我们这个矩阵最后一个非对角元在40次迭代中淡到了10的负15次方。把全部八个都求出来，需要623次。

dfa62f990f86.en: Three refinements make it fast. <bookmark mark='a'/> First, reduce the matrix once, with Householder mirrors on both sides, to Hessenberg form, zero below the first subdiagonal; a symmetric matrix becomes tridiagonal. The QR algorithm keeps this shape, and each step then costs n squared with Givens rotations, not n cubed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Second, shift: subtract a guess at an eigenvalue before factoring, and add it back after. James Wilkinson's shift is an eigenvalue of the bottom two by two block. <bookmark mark='c'/> Third, deflate: when the last subdiagonal entry is negligible, the bottom eigenvalue is found, and the iteration carries on with a smaller matrix. <bookmark mark='d'/> With all three, our eight eigenvalues take 16 iterations instead of 623.
dfa62f990f86.zh: 三项改进让它变快。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一，用两侧的 Householder 镜子，把矩阵一次性约化为 Hessenberg 形式，也就是第一条次对角线以下全为零；对称矩阵则变成三对角的。QR 算法保持这种形状，于是每一步用 Givens 旋转只花 n 的平方，而不是 n 的立方。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二，位移：分解之前减去对某个特征值的猜测，分解之后再加回来。詹姆斯·威尔金森的位移，是右下角那个二乘二块的一个特征值。<bookmark mark='c'/>第三，收缩：当最后一个次对角元小到可以忽略时，最下面的特征值就求出来了，迭代在一个更小的矩阵上继续。<bookmark mark='d'/>三项都用上，我们的八个特征值只需要16次迭代，而不是623次。

1ecc357f6d2a.en: Here is why the shift matters. <bookmark mark='a'/> Without it, the last subdiagonal entry shrinks by a constant factor each step: a straight line on a log scale, linear convergence. <bookmark mark='b'/> With Wilkinson's shift it goes from eight times ten to the minus four, to four times ten to the minus twelve, to three times ten to the minus thirty-five. <bookmark mark='c'/> The number of correct digits roughly triples each time; the measured orders are about three point seven and three. That is cubic convergence, and Wilkinson proved in 1968 that, with his shift, the symmetric iteration always converges. <bookmark mark='d'/> The answers agree with LAPACK's to about ten to the minus fourteen. Nearly every eigenvalue you have ever been shown was computed this way.
1ecc357f6d2a.zh: 这就是位移之所以重要的原因。<bookmark mark='a'/>没有位移时，最后一个次对角元每一步按一个常数因子缩小：在对数刻度上是一条直线，也就是线性收敛。<bookmark mark='b'/>用了威尔金森的位移，它从8乘以10的负4次方，变成4乘以10的负12次方，再变成3乘以10的负35次方。<bookmark mark='c'/>正确的位数每次大约变成三倍；测得的阶大约是3.7和3。这就是三次收敛，而威尔金森在1968年证明，用他的位移，对称情形的迭代总是收敛的。<bookmark mark='d'/>这些答案与 LAPACK 的结果吻合到大约10的负14次方。你见过的几乎每一个特征值，都是这样算出来的。

7093b7912796.en: For a symmetric positive definite matrix, solving A x equals b is the same as going downhill. <bookmark mark='a'/> Define phi of x as a half x transposed A x, minus b transposed x. It is a bowl, and these ellipses are its contours. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its gradient is A x minus b: <bookmark mark='c'/> zero exactly at the solution, and minus the residual everywhere else. <bookmark mark='d'/> So Part 23's gradient descent applies. Step along the residual for as long as the bowl keeps falling, and repeat. In a long, narrow bowl it zigzags, each step undoing part of the last. <bookmark mark='e'/> Conjugate gradients, on the same bowl, arrives in two steps.
7093b7912796.zh: 对一个对称正定矩阵来说，求解 A x 等于 b，就等同于走下坡路。<bookmark mark='a'/>定义 φ(x) 为二分之一 x 转置 A x，减去 b 转置 x。它是一只碗，这些椭圆是它的等高线。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的梯度是 A x 减 b：<bookmark mark='c'/>恰好在解处为零，在其他各处都是负的残差。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以第23部分的梯度下降就派上了用场。沿着残差走，只要碗还在往下降就一直走，然后重复。在一只又长又窄的碗里，它会走之字形，每一步都抵消掉上一步的一部分。<bookmark mark='e'/>共轭梯度法在同一只碗上，两步就到了。

db4495d4c4ae.en: Why two steps? The conjugate gradient method of Magnus Hestenes and Eduard Stiefel, from 1952, does more than go downhill. <bookmark mark='a'/> After k steps, the only vectors it can have built from b are combinations of b, A b, A squared b, and so on: the Krylov space. <bookmark mark='b'/> Conjugate gradients picks the best point in that whole space, in the bowl's own norm, not just the best along one line. <bookmark mark='c'/> It can, because its search directions are conjugate, orthogonal in A's inner product, so a new step never spoils the old ones. <bookmark mark='d'/> The loop is short: one product with A, two inner products, four vectors of memory. In exact arithmetic it ends within n steps; in practice, far sooner.
db4495d4c4ae.zh: 为什么是两步？Magnus Hestenes 和 Eduard Stiefel 1952年的共轭梯度法，做的不只是走下坡路。<bookmark mark='a'/>走了 k 步之后，它能从 b 构造出来的向量，只有 b、A b、A 的平方乘 b 等等的组合：这就是 Krylov 子空间。<bookmark mark='b'/>共轭梯度法在整个子空间里挑出最好的点，用的是碗自己的范数，而不只是沿一条直线上最好的点。<bookmark mark='c'/>它之所以做得到，是因为它的搜索方向是共轭的，也就是在 A 的内积下正交，所以新的一步永远不会破坏旧的几步。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个循环很短：一次与 A 的乘积，两次内积，四个向量的内存。在精确算术下，它在 n 步之内结束；在实践中，要早得多。

3434c1b177b8.en: How fast is it? <bookmark mark='a'/> The error falls at least as fast as twice a ratio to the power k: root kappa minus one, over root kappa plus one. <bookmark mark='b'/> For large kappa that ratio is about one minus two over root kappa, <bookmark mark='c'/> so the number of steps grows like the square root of the condition number. <bookmark mark='d'/> Steepest descent has kappa where conjugate gradients has its square root. <bookmark mark='e'/> Our instrument solves the Poisson problem, chapter eight's matrix, on three grids; kappa grows with the number of unknowns. Steepest descent needs 897 steps on the smallest grid and 3,297 on the next, and on the largest grid had not converged after eight thousand. Conjugate gradients needs 52, 101 and 198, about half of what the bound allows.
3434c1b177b8.zh: 它有多快？<bookmark mark='a'/>误差下降得至少和一个比值的 k 次方的两倍一样快：根号 κ 减1，除以根号 κ 加1。<bookmark mark='b'/>当 κ 很大时，这个比值大约是1减去根号 κ 分之二，<bookmark mark='c'/>所以步数像条件数的平方根那样增长。<bookmark mark='d'/>在共轭梯度法是 κ 的平方根的地方，最速下降法是 κ 本身。<bookmark mark='e'/>我们的仪器在三个网格上求解泊松问题，也就是第八章的矩阵；κ 随未知数的个数增长。最速下降法在最小的网格上需要897步，在下一个网格上需要3297步，而在最大的网格上，八千步之后还没有收敛。共轭梯度法需要52步、101步和198步，大约是那个界所允许的一半。

21a52e4b0ec1.en: Since the cost depends on kappa, change kappa. <bookmark mark='a'/> Multiply the system by the inverse of a matrix M that resembles A but is cheap to solve with. The solution is unchanged, and if M is a good imitation, M inverse A has a much smaller condition number. <bookmark mark='b'/> The simplest choice, A's own diagonal, does nothing here: the Poisson matrix has fours all along its diagonal, and the step counts are identical. <bookmark mark='c'/> Symmetric successive over-relaxation, two triangular sweeps, cuts 101 steps to 26, and 198 to 47. <bookmark mark='d'/> Incomplete Cholesky factors do better still, and chapter nine's multigrid can make the count independent of the grid.
21a52e4b0ec1.zh: 既然代价取决于 κ，那就改变 κ。<bookmark mark='a'/>把方程组乘以一个矩阵 M 的逆，M 很像 A，但用它来求解很便宜。解不变，而如果 M 模仿得好，M 的逆乘 A 的条件数就会小得多。<bookmark mark='b'/>最简单的选择，A 自己的对角线，在这里毫无作用：泊松矩阵的对角线上全是4，步数完全相同。<bookmark mark='c'/>对称逐次超松弛，也就是两次三角扫描，把101步减到26步，把198步减到47步。<bookmark mark='d'/>不完全 Cholesky 分解效果还要更好，而第九章的多重网格能让步数与网格无关。

09cff18d2657.en: Conjugate gradients needs a symmetric matrix. Add a flow, convection as well as diffusion, and symmetry is lost. <bookmark mark='a'/> GMRES, by Yousef Saad and Martin Schultz in 1986, builds an orthonormal basis of the Krylov space with Arnoldi's process, which is chapter four's modified Gram–Schmidt. A times the basis is the next basis times a small Hessenberg matrix, chapter six's shape. <bookmark mark='b'/> It looks for x in that space, <bookmark mark='c'/> and minimizes the residual through a small least-squares problem, solved with Givens rotations. <bookmark mark='d'/> On our nonsymmetric problem of a thousand and twenty-four unknowns, it reaches ten to the minus eight in 82 steps. <bookmark mark='e'/> The price is memory: every basis vector is kept, so long runs are restarted.
09cff18d2657.zh: 共轭梯度法需要对称矩阵。加上一股流动，也就是在扩散之外再加上对流，对称性就失去了。<bookmark mark='a'/>Yousef Saad 和 Martin Schultz 1986年提出的 GMRES，用 Arnoldi 过程构造 Krylov 子空间的一组标准正交基，而 Arnoldi 过程就是第四章的修正 Gram–Schmidt。A 乘以这组基，等于下一组基乘以一个小的 Hessenberg 矩阵，也就是第六章的那种形状。<bookmark mark='b'/>它在这个子空间里寻找 x，<bookmark mark='c'/>并通过一个小的最小二乘问题让残差最小，这个问题用 Givens 旋转求解。<bookmark mark='d'/>在我们那个有1024个未知数的非对称问题上，它在82步内达到10的负8次方。<bookmark mark='e'/>代价是内存：每一个基向量都要保存，所以长时间的运行要重新启动。

20aa0b280a54.en: The matrices of chapters seven and nine come from equations like Poisson's, which governs steady heat, electric potential and pressure. <bookmark mark='a'/> We want u on a square, given f, with u zero on the edge. Sample u on a grid with spacing h. <bookmark mark='b'/> Adding the Taylor series of u at x plus h and at x minus h cancels the odd terms, <bookmark mark='c'/> so the second derivative becomes a second difference, divided by h squared. <bookmark mark='d'/> Do the same in y and add: each grid point is coupled to its four neighbours, four times itself minus each neighbour once. That is one equation per grid point, with at most five unknowns in each.
20aa0b280a54.zh: 第七章和第九章的矩阵，来自泊松方程这样的方程，它支配着稳态的热、电势和压强。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们要在一个正方形上求 u，已知 f，并且 u 在边界上为零。在一个间距为 h 的网格上对 u 采样。<bookmark mark='b'/>把 u 在 x 加 h 和 x 减 h 处的泰勒级数相加，奇数次项就抵消了，<bookmark mark='c'/>于是二阶导数变成二阶差分，再除以 h 的平方。<bookmark mark='d'/>在 y 方向做同样的事再相加：每个网格点与它的四个邻居耦合，自身的4倍减去每个邻居各一次。这就是每个网格点一个方程，每个方程至多五个未知数。

4064ee5df42d.en: Number the grid points row by row, and almost every entry of the matrix is zero. <bookmark mark='a'/> Compressed sparse row format stores only the nonzeros: their values, row by row, <bookmark mark='b'/> their column numbers, <bookmark mark='c'/> and where each row starts. <bookmark mark='d'/> Multiplying by a vector walks those arrays once, two operations per nonzero. Each load of x at a column number lands somewhere unpredictable, so the product is limited by memory bandwidth, as in Part 9. <bookmark mark='e'/> For a sixty-four by sixty-four grid, four thousand and ninety-six unknowns, the matrix has 20,224 nonzeros: about two hundred and sixty kilobytes in this format, against a hundred and thirty-four megabytes stored densely.
4064ee5df42d.zh: 把网格点一行一行地编号，矩阵几乎每个元素都是零。<bookmark mark='a'/>压缩稀疏行格式只存储非零元：它们的值，一行接一行，<bookmark mark='b'/>它们的列号，<bookmark mark='c'/>以及每一行从哪里开始。<bookmark mark='d'/>乘以一个向量，就是把这些数组走一遍，每个非零元两次运算。按列号每读取一次 x，都会落到一个无法预测的地方，所以这个乘积受内存带宽限制，就像第9部分那样。<bookmark mark='e'/>对一个64乘64的网格，也就是4096个未知数，这个矩阵有20224个非零元：用这种格式大约是260千字节，而稠密存储要134兆字节。

443aa10e0573.en: Direct solvers factor the matrix, and there sparsity is fragile. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this arrow matrix one unknown, the hub, is coupled to all the others. Seymour Parter's view of elimination, from 1961, is a graph: eliminating an unknown couples all of its neighbours to one another. <bookmark mark='b'/> Eliminate the hub first and every pair of the others becomes coupled: the factor fills in completely. <bookmark mark='c'/> Eliminate it last, and nothing fills in at all. Same matrix, same answer; only the order differs. <bookmark mark='d'/> On the sixty-four by sixty-four grid, numbered row by row, the Cholesky factor has two hundred and sixty-two thousand nonzeros, 13 times as many as the matrix.
443aa10e0573.zh: 直接求解器要分解矩阵，而在那里，稀疏性很脆弱。<bookmark mark='a'/>在这个箭形矩阵里，一个未知数，也就是中心，与其他所有未知数耦合。Seymour Parter 1961年对消去法的看法是一张图：消去一个未知数，会让它的所有邻居彼此耦合起来。<bookmark mark='b'/>先消去中心，其他未知数两两之间就都耦合了：因子被完全填满。<bookmark mark='c'/>最后消去它，就什么都不会填充。同一个矩阵，同一个答案；不同的只是次序。<bookmark mark='d'/>在64乘64的网格上，一行一行地编号，Cholesky 因子有26万2000个非零元，是矩阵的13倍。

94f4fc934cda.en: So the order of elimination is the whole game. <bookmark mark='a'/> Numbered row by row, the grid is eliminated like a broom sweeping a floor, and the front of partly eliminated unknowns couples everything behind it to everything ahead: a band of width m fills completely. <bookmark mark='b'/> Minimum degree, a greedy rule that goes back to Harry Markowitz in 1957, always eliminates the unknown with the fewest neighbours next. <bookmark mark='c'/> Nested dissection, Alan George's idea of 1973, cuts the grid in two with a line of unknowns, numbers the line last, and does the same to each half. <bookmark mark='d'/> On a two-dimensional grid its fill grows like n log n and its work like n to the three halves, which is the best possible order of growth.
94f4fc934cda.zh: 所以，消去的次序就是全部的关键。<bookmark mark='a'/>一行一行地编号，网格就像扫帚扫地那样被消去，部分消去的未知数构成的前沿，把它身后的一切与它前方的一切耦合起来：宽度为 m 的带被完全填满。<bookmark mark='b'/>最小度排序是一条贪心规则，可以追溯到1957年的 Harry Markowitz，它总是接下来消去邻居最少的那个未知数。<bookmark mark='c'/>嵌套剖分是 Alan George 1973年的想法，它用一条由未知数组成的线把网格一分为二，把这条线最后编号，再对每一半做同样的事。<bookmark mark='d'/>在二维网格上，它的填充像 n log n 那样增长，工作量像 n 的二分之三次方那样增长，这是可能达到的最好的增长阶。

726fb07ee0bf.en: Here is what the orderings buy on our grid of four thousand and ninety-six unknowns. <bookmark mark='a'/> Row by row, the factor has two hundred and sixty-two thousand nonzeros. Reverse Cuthill–McKee, which only narrows the band, a hundred and eighty-one thousand. <bookmark mark='b'/> Minimum degree, sixty-three thousand, about three times the matrix itself; our simple nested dissection, eighty-nine thousand. <bookmark mark='c'/> Nested dissection's advantages are growth and parallelism: its halves are independent, which is why libraries such as METIS use it on large meshes. When the grid side doubles, row-by-row fill grows eightfold, the good orderings' less than sixfold. <bookmark mark='d'/> In three dimensions the separators are planes, fill grows like n to the four thirds, and iterative methods take over.
726fb07ee0bf.zh: 这就是各种排序在我们那个有4096个未知数的网格上换来的东西。<bookmark mark='a'/>一行一行地编号，因子有26万2000个非零元。逆 Cuthill–McKee 排序只把带变窄，是18万1000个。<bookmark mark='b'/>最小度排序，6万3000个，大约是矩阵本身的3倍；我们那个简单的嵌套剖分，8万9000个。<bookmark mark='c'/>嵌套剖分的优势在于增长和并行性：它的两半彼此独立，这就是为什么 METIS 这样的库在大型网格上使用它。当网格的边长翻倍时，逐行编号的填充增长到8倍，好的排序则不到6倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>在三维中，分隔集是平面，填充像 n 的三分之四次方那样增长，于是迭代方法接管了一切。

56a2ff8f5657.en: Go back to Poisson's equation, in one dimension to start: sixty-three unknowns, two on the diagonal and minus one beside it. <bookmark mark='a'/> The simplest iteration, weighted Jacobi, moves each unknown part of the way towards the value its own equation wants. <bookmark mark='b'/> Subtract the true solution and b cancels: the error is multiplied by the same matrix at every sweep. <bookmark mark='c'/> That matrix shares its eigenvectors with A, and they are sine waves: mode one is a single smooth hump, mode sixty-three a zigzag. <bookmark mark='d'/> So each sweep simply scales each mode, by a factor we can write down. <bookmark mark='e'/> Moving two thirds of the way, the rough upper half of the modes shrinks by at least a factor of three per sweep. The smoothest mode keeps nought point nine nine nine of itself.
56a2ff8f5657.zh: 回到泊松方程，先从一维开始：63个未知数，对角线上是2，旁边是负1。<bookmark mark='a'/>最简单的迭代，加权 Jacobi 迭代，把每个未知数朝它自己的方程想要的值移动一段距离。<bookmark mark='b'/>减去真解，b 就抵消了：每次扫描，误差都乘以同一个矩阵。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个矩阵与 A 有相同的特征向量，它们都是正弦波：第1个模态是一个平滑的单峰，第63个模态是一条锯齿。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以每次扫描只是把每个模态缩放一下，缩放因子我们可以写出来。<bookmark mark='e'/>每次移动三分之二的距离，模态中粗糙的上半部分，每次扫描至少缩小到三分之一。最平滑的模态则保留了自身的0.999。

280d7b0f9e7b.en: Watch it happen. <bookmark mark='a'/> These bars are a random error, measured along each of the sixty-three sine waves: smooth modes on the left, rough ones on the right. <bookmark mark='b'/> One sweep, and the right half drops. <bookmark mark='c'/> Three sweeps. <bookmark mark='d'/> After ten, the rough half has all but vanished, and the smoothest mode has lost less than one percent. <bookmark mark='e'/> So relaxation on its own is hopeless: the error that remains is smooth, and smooth error barely moves. But relaxation does one thing superbly. It smooths.
280d7b0f9e7b.zh: 看它是怎么发生的。<bookmark mark='a'/>这些柱条是一个随机误差，沿着63个正弦波中的每一个来度量：平滑的模态在左边，粗糙的在右边。<bookmark mark='b'/>扫描一次，右半边就降下去了。<bookmark mark='c'/>扫描三次。<bookmark mark='d'/>十次之后，粗糙的那一半几乎完全消失，而最平滑的模态损失还不到百分之一。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以单靠松弛是没有希望的：剩下的误差是平滑的，而平滑的误差几乎不动。但松弛有一件事做得极好。它会把误差变平滑。

fc476a55206f.en: Here is the trick. <bookmark mark='a'/> A smooth wave on a fine grid of fifteen points, mode six, sits in the lower half of the spectrum, where relaxation is slow. <bookmark mark='b'/> Keep every other point. On the coarse grid of seven, the same wave is mode six of seven: in the upper half, where relaxation is fast. <bookmark mark='c'/> So relax a few times, compute the residual, and carry it down to the coarse grid. Solve there for the correction, interpolate it back, add it, and relax again. Radii Fedorenko published this two-grid scheme in 1964, and Achi Brandt made it practical in the 1970s. <bookmark mark='d'/> The coarse problem is the same kind of problem, so treat it the same way.
fc476a55206f.zh: 诀窍是这样的。<bookmark mark='a'/>在一个15个点的细网格上，一个平滑的波，第6个模态，位于频谱的下半部分，那里松弛很慢。<bookmark mark='b'/>每隔一个点保留一个。在7个点的粗网格上，同一个波是7个模态中的第6个：位于上半部分，那里松弛很快。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以先松弛几次，算出残差，把它传到粗网格上。在那里解出修正量，把它插值回来，加上去，再松弛一次。Radii Fedorenko 在1964年发表了这种两重网格方案，而 Achi Brandt 在1970年代让它变得实用。<bookmark mark='d'/>粗网格上的问题是同一类问题，所以用同样的方法对待它。

161038885c40.en: Recursing gives the V-cycle. <bookmark mark='a'/> Relax and restrict, down through coarser and coarser grids to one of a few points; solve that exactly; then interpolate and relax on the way back up. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our instrument runs it on the two-dimensional Poisson problem. On a grid of two hundred and twenty-five unknowns, each cycle cuts the residual by a factor of about five. <bookmark mark='c'/> On nine hundred and sixty-one unknowns, the same. On sixteen thousand, the same. The curves lie on top of one another, and ten cycles reach a few parts in a hundred million on every grid. The number of cycles does not grow with the problem.
161038885c40.zh: 递归下去，就得到 V 循环。<bookmark mark='a'/>松弛并限制，穿过越来越粗的网格，一直到只有几个点的网格；在那里精确求解；然后在回来的路上插值并松弛。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的仪器在二维泊松问题上运行它。在一个有225个未知数的网格上，每个循环把残差缩小到大约五分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>在961个未知数上，一样。在16000个未知数上，还是一样。这些曲线彼此重叠，在每个网格上，十个循环都能达到亿分之几。循环的次数不随问题增长。

3340941e58ad.en: And each cycle is cheap. <bookmark mark='a'/> It relaxes on the finest grid, work proportional to n, and then does the same on a grid with a quarter of the points. <bookmark mark='b'/> Unroll that: n, times one plus a quarter plus a sixteenth and so on, <bookmark mark='c'/> which is four thirds of the work on the finest grid alone. <bookmark mark='d'/> Now compare the ways of solving the same Poisson problem. Dense elimination grows like n cubed; the band, row by row, like n squared; nested dissection, and conjugate gradients, like n to the three halves. Multigrid grows like n. <bookmark mark='e'/> That is the cost of reading the right-hand side, so no method can do better. For unstructured problems, algebraic multigrid builds its coarse levels from the matrix itself, and is often the preconditioner inside conjugate gradients.
3340941e58ad.zh: 而且每个循环都很便宜。<bookmark mark='a'/>它在最细的网格上松弛，工作量与 n 成正比，然后在一个点数只有四分之一的网格上做同样的事。<bookmark mark='b'/>把它展开：n 乘以一加四分之一加十六分之一，依此类推，<bookmark mark='c'/>也就是单在最细网格上的工作量的三分之四。<bookmark mark='d'/>现在比较一下求解同一个泊松问题的各种方法。稠密消去像 n 的立方那样增长；逐行编号的带状消去，像 n 的平方；嵌套剖分和共轭梯度法，像 n 的二分之三次方。多重网格像 n 那样增长。<bookmark mark='e'/>这就是读一遍右端项的代价，所以没有任何方法能做得更好。对于非结构化的问题，代数多重网格从矩阵本身构造它的粗层级，它常常就是共轭梯度法里面的那个预条件子。

f368b5a9d68f.en: Chapter ten. Roots, and Newton's fractal.
f368b5a9d68f.zh: 第十章：求根，以及牛顿分形。

9c8bfe85ed64.en: Every method in this chapter hunts for a zero, and our test case is the square root of two, the positive root of x squared minus two. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bisection needs only a sign change. f is negative at one and positive at two, so a root lies between them. <bookmark mark='b'/> Evaluate the midpoint, keep the half that still changes sign, and repeat. The bracket halves every time, <bookmark mark='c'/> so each step gains one bit, about three tenths of a decimal digit. Bisection cannot fail, and it is slow: after forty steps, twelve digits.
9c8bfe85ed64.zh: 这一章里的每一种方法都在寻找一个零点，而我们的测试例子是2的平方根，也就是 x 的平方减2的正根。<bookmark mark='a'/>二分法只需要一次变号。f 在1处为负，在2处为正，所以有一个根位于两者之间。<bookmark mark='b'/>计算中点的值，保留仍然变号的那一半，然后重复。区间每次都减半，<bookmark mark='c'/>所以每一步得到一个比特，大约是十分之三位十进制数字。二分法不会失败，但它很慢：四十步之后，12位数字。

b8d60761c2ff.en: Newton's method uses the slope as well. <bookmark mark='a'/> Near x, f of x plus h is about f of x plus f prime of x times h: the tangent line. <bookmark mark='b'/> Set that to zero, solve for h, <bookmark mark='c'/> and step. From two, the tangent lands at one and a half, and the next at one point four one six seven. <bookmark mark='d'/> Keep one more term of Taylor's series, and the new error is a constant times the old error squared. An error of a thousandth becomes about a millionth: the correct digits double at every step. <bookmark mark='e'/> The secant method replaces the derivative by the slope through the last two points. Its order is the golden ratio, one point six one eight.
b8d60761c2ff.zh: 牛顿法还利用了斜率。<bookmark mark='a'/>在 x 附近，f 在 x 加 h 处的值，大约等于 f(x) 加上 f 撇 x 乘以 h：这就是切线。<bookmark mark='b'/>令它等于零，解出 h，<bookmark mark='c'/>然后迈出一步。从2出发，切线落在1.5，下一次落在1.4167。<bookmark mark='d'/>在泰勒级数中再多保留一项，新的误差就是一个常数乘以旧误差的平方。千分之一的误差变成大约百万分之一：正确的位数每一步都翻倍。<bookmark mark='e'/>割线法把导数换成经过最近两个点的斜率。它的阶是黄金比，1.618。

74136890344f.en: Here is the race, computed. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bisection climbs its straight line, three tenths of a digit per step. <bookmark mark='b'/> The secant method's correct digits go one, two, three, six, nine and a half, then nearly sixteen, the limit of double precision. <bookmark mark='c'/> Newton's go one, two and a half, five and a half, twelve, sixteen: doubling. <bookmark mark='d'/> But each Newton step evaluates both f and its derivative. Counted per evaluation, Newton's order is the square root of two, and the secant method, at one point six one eight, is the faster of the two.
74136890344f.zh: 这就是这场比赛，实际算出来的。<bookmark mark='a'/>二分法沿着它的直线往上爬，每步十分之三位数字。<bookmark mark='b'/>割线法的正确位数是1、2、3、6、9.5，然后接近16，这是双精度的极限。<bookmark mark='c'/>牛顿法的是1、2.5、5.5、12、16：翻倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>但牛顿法的每一步，既要计算 f，又要计算它的导数。按每次函数求值来算，牛顿法的阶是2的平方根，而割线法的1.618，是两者中更快的那一个。

e53833a624a3.en: Newton's method works for complex numbers too, and in 1879 Arthur Cayley asked which root it finds from a given start. For z squared minus one the answer is simple: the nearer root. <bookmark mark='a'/> For z cubed minus one, colour every starting point by the root it reaches, darker where it takes longer. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each root sits in a calm basin of its own colour. <bookmark mark='c'/> But the boundary between basins is not a line. Wherever two colours meet, the third appears between them, in smaller and smaller copies.
e53833a624a3.zh: 牛顿法对复数也适用，1879年，Arthur Cayley 问：从一个给定的起点出发，它会找到哪个根？对 z 的平方减1，答案很简单：较近的那个根。<bookmark mark='a'/>对 z 的立方减1，按照每个起点最终到达的根给它着色，花的时间越长，颜色越深。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个根都坐落在一片属于自己颜色的、平静的吸引域里。<bookmark mark='c'/>但吸引域之间的边界不是一条线。只要两种颜色相遇，第三种颜色就会出现在它们之间，形成越来越小的副本。

14e290686a53.en: Zoom in. <bookmark mark='a'/> A window fifteen times smaller, on the boundary: the same structure, buds on buds. In the exact picture it never ends, because every point on the boundary of one basin is on the boundary of all three. <bookmark mark='b'/> Zoom twenty times further, but into the interior of a basin, and the picture goes flat: every start there reaches the same root in six steps. <bookmark mark='c'/> Fast near a root, unpredictable far from one: that is why the root finders in libraries are safeguarded. Brent's method, from 1973, keeps a bisection bracket and takes fast interpolation steps only while they stay inside it.
14e290686a53.zh: 放大来看。<bookmark mark='a'/>在边界上取一个小15倍的窗口：同样的结构，花蕾上长着花蕾。在精确的图景中，它永无止境，因为一个吸引域边界上的每一个点，都同时位于所有三个吸引域的边界上。<bookmark mark='b'/>再放大20倍，但这次是放大到一个吸引域的内部，图景就变平了：那里的每个起点都在6步内到达同一个根。<bookmark mark='c'/>在根附近很快，离根远时无法预测：这就是为什么函数库里的求根程序都带有保护措施。Brent 方法来自1973年，它保持一个二分区间，只在快速的插值步留在区间之内时才采用它们。

bdda2c639afb.en: To stand in for a function, the obvious idea is to sample it and pass a polynomial through the samples. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1901 Carl Runge tried it on a perfectly smooth function, one over one plus twenty-five x squared. <bookmark mark='b'/> Through eleven equally spaced points, the polynomial follows it in the middle but swings near the ends. <bookmark mark='c'/> Through twenty-one points it is far worse: near the ends the error is about sixty. <bookmark mark='d'/> With eighty-one points it is six times ten to the fourteen. More data gives a worse answer. The function is innocent: the points are to blame.
bdda2c639afb.zh: 要替代一个函数，显而易见的想法是对它采样，再让一个多项式穿过这些样本点。<bookmark mark='a'/>1901年，Carl Runge 在一个完全光滑的函数上试了这个方法：1加25 x 平方分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>穿过11个等距点，多项式在中间跟得上它，但在两端附近摆动。<bookmark mark='c'/>穿过21个点，情况糟得多：在两端附近，误差大约是60。<bookmark mark='d'/>用81个点，误差是6乘以10的14次方。数据越多，答案越差。函数是无辜的：该怪的是那些点。

5a719fc710e1.en: The cure is to choose the points. <bookmark mark='a'/> Space points evenly around a semicircle and drop them onto the diameter. These are Chebyshev points, crowded towards the ends. <bookmark mark='b'/> Why there? The interpolation error is a derivative of f, which we cannot change, <bookmark mark='c'/> times the node polynomial, the product of x minus each sample point, which we can. <bookmark mark='d'/> For equally spaced points it is small in the middle and nearly a hundred times larger near the ends. For Chebyshev points it ripples evenly and never exceeds two to the one minus n, within a factor of two of the smallest maximum any choice of points can have.
5a719fc710e1.zh: 解药是选择这些点。<bookmark mark='a'/>在一个半圆上均匀地取点，再把它们投到直径上。这些就是切比雪夫点，它们朝两端聚集。<bookmark mark='b'/>为什么在那里？插值误差是 f 的某阶导数，这个我们改变不了，<bookmark mark='c'/>乘以节点多项式，也就是 x 减去每个采样点的乘积，这个我们可以改变。<bookmark mark='d'/>对等距点，它在中间很小，在两端附近要大将近100倍。对切比雪夫点，它均匀地起伏，永远不超过2的1减 n 次方，与任何一种选点方式所能达到的最小最大值相比，相差不到两倍。

f551ec035abe.en: Here is the difference, computed. <bookmark mark='a'/> Through twenty-one Chebyshev points, the polynomial is already within two hundredths of Runge's function everywhere. <bookmark mark='b'/> As the degree grows, the equispaced error explodes, and the Chebyshev error falls geometrically, to about one ten-millionth at degree eighty. <bookmark mark='c'/> The rate is set by where f stops being smooth: poles at plus and minus i over five, off the real line. <bookmark mark='d'/> The ellipse around the interval that passes through them has a parameter rho, one plus root twenty-six, over five, about one point two two, <bookmark mark='e'/> and the error falls like rho to the minus n: the dashed line.
f551ec035abe.zh: 这就是两者的差别，实际算出来的。<bookmark mark='a'/>穿过21个切比雪夫点，多项式就已经处处与 Runge 函数相差不到百分之二。<bookmark mark='b'/>随着次数增长，等距点的误差爆炸，而切比雪夫点的误差按几何级数下降，到80次时降到大约一千万分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个速率由 f 在哪里不再光滑决定：在正负 i 除以5处的极点，它们不在实轴上。<bookmark mark='d'/>围绕这个区间、穿过这两个极点的椭圆有一个参数 ρ，等于1加根号26，再除以5，大约是1.22，<bookmark mark='e'/>而误差像 ρ 的负 n 次方那样下降：就是那条虚线。

aea7b964756e.en: How should a computer evaluate the interpolating polynomial? <bookmark mark='a'/> Lagrange's formula costs order n squared operations at every point, and has a reputation for instability. <bookmark mark='b'/> Pull the node polynomial out of each Lagrange basis function: what is left is a weight over x minus x j. <bookmark mark='c'/> That gives the first barycentric form. <bookmark mark='d'/> Now interpolate the constant function one, which any interpolant reproduces exactly. <bookmark mark='e'/> Divide the first equation by this one, and the node polynomial cancels. What remains costs order n per point. <bookmark mark='f'/> For Chebyshev points the weights are just plus and minus one, halved at the ends, and Nicholas Higham proved in 2004 that the formula is stable. Every curve in this chapter was evaluated this way.
aea7b964756e.zh: 计算机应该怎样计算插值多项式？<bookmark mark='a'/>拉格朗日公式在每个点上都要花 n 的平方阶次运算，而且素有不稳定的名声。<bookmark mark='b'/>把节点多项式从每个拉格朗日基函数中提出来：剩下的是一个权重除以 x 减 x j。<bookmark mark='c'/>这就给出了第一种重心形式。<bookmark mark='d'/>现在对常数函数1做插值，任何插值都能精确地重现它。<bookmark mark='e'/>把第一个等式除以这一个，节点多项式就消掉了。剩下的每个点只花 n 阶次运算。<bookmark mark='f'/>对切比雪夫点，权重就是正负1，两端减半，而 Nicholas Higham 在2004年证明了这个公式是稳定的。这一章里的每一条曲线，都是这样计算出来的。

f4c2a8ff9b68.en: Zachary Battles and Lloyd Trefethen took this to its conclusion in 2004, with Chebfun. <bookmark mark='a'/> Represent a function by its values at Chebyshev points, enough of them that its Chebyshev coefficients have fallen to rounding level: try seventeen points, then thirty-three, sixty-five, and so on, until the tail is noise, and chop it there. <bookmark mark='b'/> For Runge's function, the rate we just found predicts about a hundred and eighty-five. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then compute with the function itself, to about fifteen digits: integrate it, differentiate it, find its maximum, and find all its roots at once, as the eigenvalues of a matrix built from its coefficients, chapter six again. <bookmark mark='d'/> Numerical computing with functions, not just numbers.
f4c2a8ff9b68.zh: Zachary Battles 和 Lloyd Trefethen 在2004年用 Chebfun 把这个思路推向了它的结论。<bookmark mark='a'/>用一个函数在切比雪夫点上的值来表示它，点要足够多，使它的切比雪夫系数降到舍入水平：先试17个点，然后33个、65个，依此类推，直到尾部成了噪声，就在那里截断。<bookmark mark='b'/>对 Runge 函数，我们刚才得到的速率预测大约需要185个。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后直接用这个函数本身来计算，精确到大约15位数字：对它积分、求导、求它的最大值，并一次求出它的所有根，作为由它的系数构造的一个矩阵的特征值，又是第六章。<bookmark mark='d'/>用函数做数值计算，而不只是用数。

38156fcdd5e6.en: To integrate, sample the function and add up. Our test integral is e to the x times cosine three x, from nought to two. Its exact value is about minus one hundredth: a small difference of large areas. <bookmark mark='a'/> The trapezoid rule joins the samples with straight lines. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its error shrinks like h squared: halve the spacing and the error falls fourfold. <bookmark mark='c'/> Combine two trapezoid sums, four times the finer one minus the coarser, over three, and the h squared terms cancel. That is Simpson's rule, <bookmark mark='d'/> and its error falls like h to the fourth.
38156fcdd5e6.zh: 要做积分，就对函数采样，再加起来。我们的测试积分是 e 的 x 次方乘以余弦3x，从0到2。它的精确值大约是负百分之一：是几块大面积之间的一个小差。<bookmark mark='a'/>梯形法则用直线把样本点连起来。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的误差像 h 的平方那样缩小：间距减半，误差就降到四分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>把两个梯形和组合起来，较细的那个的4倍减去较粗的那个，再除以3，h 的平方项就抵消了。这就是 Simpson 法则，<bookmark mark='d'/>它的误差像 h 的四次方那样下降。

36131ad0d08f.en: Both rules fix the sample points and choose only the weights. In 1814 Carl Friedrich Gauss chose the points too. <bookmark mark='a'/> With two points there are four unknowns, two nodes and two weights, <bookmark mark='b'/> so we may demand the right answer for one, x, x squared and x cubed. <bookmark mark='c'/> Solving gives weights of one at plus and minus one over root three: two samples, exact for every cubic. <bookmark mark='d'/> With n points the rule is exact up to degree two n minus one. The nodes are the roots of Legendre polynomials, crowded towards the ends like chapter eleven's Chebyshev points. <bookmark mark='e'/> Gene Golub and John Welsch showed in 1969 that they are the eigenvalues of a symmetric tridiagonal matrix, so chapter six's QR algorithm computes them.
36131ad0d08f.zh: 这两种法则都固定了采样点，只选择权重。1814年，卡尔·弗里德里希·高斯把采样点也一起选了。<bookmark mark='a'/>用两个点，就有四个未知数，两个节点和两个权重，<bookmark mark='b'/>所以我们可以要求它对1、x、x 的平方和 x 的立方都给出正确答案。<bookmark mark='c'/>解出来，是在正负根号3分之一处、权重都为1：两个样本，对每一个三次多项式都精确。<bookmark mark='d'/>用 n 个点，这个法则直到2n 减1次都是精确的。节点是 Legendre 多项式的根，像第十一章的切比雪夫点一样朝两端聚集。<bookmark mark='e'/>Gene Golub 和 John Welsch 在1969年证明，它们是一个对称三对角矩阵的特征值，所以第六章的 QR 算法就能把它们算出来。

52494869fbe4.en: Here are four rules on our integral, computed. <bookmark mark='a'/> The trapezoid error falls fourfold each time the points double, to about a thousandth at sixty-four intervals. <bookmark mark='b'/> Simpson's falls sixteenfold, to about a millionth. <bookmark mark='c'/> Gauss reaches four times ten to the minus fifteen with just sixteen points, and then can go no further: that is rounding. For a smooth integrand its error falls geometrically, like Chebyshev interpolation. <bookmark mark='d'/> Monte Carlo, the average of f at random points, is worst by far: with sixty-five samples its typical error is still more than a half.
52494869fbe4.zh: 这是四种法则在我们这个积分上的表现，实际算出来的。<bookmark mark='a'/>点数每翻一倍，梯形法则的误差就降到四分之一，到64个区间时大约是千分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>Simpson 法则的误差每次降到十六分之一，降到大约百万分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>高斯求积只用16个点就达到了4乘以10的负15次方，然后就再也下不去了：那是舍入。对光滑的被积函数，它的误差按几何级数下降，就像切比雪夫插值那样。<bookmark mark='d'/>蒙特卡洛方法，也就是 f 在随机点上的平均值，是迄今最差的：用65个样本，它的典型误差仍然超过一半。

44f9e864fef5.en: A smooth stretch deserves few points and a wild one many. Adaptive quadrature decides where, by itself. <bookmark mark='a'/> Apply Simpson's rule to an interval, and again to its two halves. <bookmark mark='b'/> Simpson's error grows like the fifth power of the width, so the two halves together err by a sixteenth as much. <bookmark mark='c'/> Subtracting gives an estimate of the error, for free. <bookmark mark='d'/> If it is small enough, accept, adding the estimate back as a correction; if not, split and recurse, each half with half the tolerance. <bookmark mark='e'/> On an integrand with a cusp, the intervals pile up at the cusp and stay wide elsewhere. On our smooth test integral, asked for ten to the minus ten, our instrument used nine hundred and eighty-five evaluations, where Gauss needed sixteen: adaptivity pays when the trouble is local.
44f9e864fef5.zh: 平坦的一段只值得用几个点，剧烈变化的一段则需要很多。自适应求积自己决定把点放在哪里。<bookmark mark='a'/>对一个区间用一次 Simpson 法则，再对它的两半各用一次。<bookmark mark='b'/>Simpson 法则的误差像宽度的五次方那样增长，所以两半合起来的误差，只有前者的十六分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>两者相减，就免费得到了一个误差估计。<bookmark mark='d'/>如果它足够小，就接受，并把这个估计加回去作为修正；如果不够小，就分割并递归，每一半用一半的容差。<bookmark mark='e'/>在一个带尖点的被积函数上，区间在尖点处堆积起来，在别处则保持宽阔。在我们那个光滑的测试积分上，要求精度为10的负10次方时，我们的仪器用了985次函数求值，而高斯求积只需要16次：问题集中在局部时，自适应才划算。

057202e60cd7.en: Monte Carlo loses in one dimension, and wins in many. <bookmark mark='a'/> An integral is an average, so estimate it by averaging f at N random points: the first algorithm on this part's list of ten, from Los Alamos. <bookmark mark='b'/> The variance of an average of N independent samples is the variance of one sample over N, <bookmark mark='c'/> so the error falls like one over root N, whatever the dimension. <bookmark mark='d'/> A grid with N points in d dimensions has spacing N to the minus one over d, and the trapezoid error falls like N to the minus two over d. <bookmark mark='e'/> Above four dimensions, Monte Carlo wins, and in the hundreds of dimensions of finance and physics nothing else is feasible.
057202e60cd7.zh: 蒙特卡洛方法在一维中输了，在多维中赢了。<bookmark mark='a'/>积分就是一个平均值，所以就用 f 在 N 个随机点上的平均值来估计它：这是这一部分那份十大算法名单上的第一个，来自洛斯阿拉莫斯。<bookmark mark='b'/>N 个独立样本的平均值的方差，是单个样本的方差除以 N，<bookmark mark='c'/>所以无论维数是多少，误差都像根号 N 分之一那样下降。<bookmark mark='d'/>在 d 维中有 N 个点的网格，间距是 N 的负 d 分之一次方，而梯形法则的误差像 N 的负 d 分之二次方那样下降。<bookmark mark='e'/>超过四维，蒙特卡洛方法就赢了，而在金融和物理中那种成百上千的维数里，别的方法都不可行。

70f3899bdfbf.en: A differential equation gives the slope of its solution everywhere, and a solver walks along it. <bookmark mark='a'/> By Taylor's series, the value a step h later is the value now, plus h times the slope, plus a term of order h squared. <bookmark mark='b'/> Dropping the rest is Euler's method: on y prime equals y, four steps of a half reach five, not seven point three nine. <bookmark mark='c'/> Carl Runge and Wilhelm Kutta sampled the slope four times per step, so that the errors cancel up to h to the fourth. <bookmark mark='d'/> The same four steps reach seven point three eight.
70f3899bdfbf.zh: 一个微分方程给出它的解在每一处的斜率，而求解器就沿着它走。<bookmark mark='a'/>根据泰勒级数，一步 h 之后的值，等于现在的值，加上 h 乘以斜率，再加上一个 h 平方阶的项。<bookmark mark='b'/>把其余部分丢掉，就是欧拉法：对 y 撇等于 y，步长为二分之一走四步，到达的是5，而不是7.39。<bookmark mark='c'/>Carl Runge 和 Wilhelm Kutta 在每一步中对斜率采样四次，让误差一直抵消到 h 的四次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>同样的四步，到达7.38。

54070017b8cd.en: How large a step? Let the method decide. <bookmark mark='a'/> The formulas of John Dormand and Peter Prince, from 1980, give two answers from the same seven slopes, of fifth and fourth order. Their difference estimates the error, which grows like h to the fifth. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ask for the next step's error to equal the tolerance. <bookmark mark='c'/> Divide, and the constant cancels: scale h by the fifth root of tolerance over error. <bookmark mark='d'/> Add a safety factor, and retry any step that fails. <bookmark mark='e'/> That is our instrument's loop, and the method behind SciPy's default solver and MATLAB's ode45.
54070017b8cd.zh: 步长该取多大？让方法自己决定。<bookmark mark='a'/>John Dormand 和 Peter Prince 1980年的公式，用同样的七个斜率给出两个答案，一个五阶，一个四阶。它们的差估计了误差，而误差像 h 的五次方那样增长。<bookmark mark='b'/>要求下一步的误差等于容差。<bookmark mark='c'/>两式相除，常数就消掉了：把 h 乘以容差除以误差的五次方根。<bookmark mark='d'/>再加上一个安全系数，并重做任何失败的一步。<bookmark mark='e'/>这就是我们仪器的循环，也是 SciPy 的默认求解器和 MATLAB 的 ode45 背后的方法。

48d793656a8f.en: Now a harder kind of equation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its solution is cosine t minus e to the lambda t: for large negative lambda, a brief transient, then just the smooth cosine. <bookmark mark='b'/> With lambda minus one, the adaptive method takes eleven steps; with minus a hundred, a hundred and thirty-two. <bookmark mark='c'/> With minus ten thousand, six thousand and sixty-seven, though after the first instant the answer is the same gentle cosine. <bookmark mark='d'/> Backward Euler takes two hundred steps every time, and its error even shrinks. This is stiffness: a decay that is already over still dictates an explicit method's step.
48d793656a8f.zh: 现在来看一类更难的方程。<bookmark mark='a'/>它的解是余弦 t 减去 e 的 λt 次方：当 λ 是很大的负数时，是一段短暂的瞬态，然后就只剩下平滑的余弦。<bookmark mark='b'/>λ 为负1时，自适应方法走了11步；为负100时，走了132步。<bookmark mark='c'/>为负10000时，走了6067步，尽管在最初的一瞬之后，答案还是那条平缓的余弦。<bookmark mark='d'/>向后欧拉法每次都走200步，而且它的误差甚至还缩小了。这就是刚性：一个早已结束的衰减，仍然支配着显式方法的步长。

81d647fcf45a.en: Why? Test each method on y prime equals lambda y, with z equal to h times lambda: each step multiplies y by some R of z. <bookmark mark='a'/> Euler's factor is one plus z: stable only in a disc around minus one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Runge–Kutta four's is its Taylor polynomial: a larger region, but still bounded. <bookmark mark='c'/> Backward Euler takes the slope at the new point, which gives one over one minus z, <bookmark mark='d'/> smaller than one in the whole left half-plane. Germund Dahlquist named this A-stability in 1963. An explicit method's factor is a polynomial, unbounded, so no explicit method is A-stable.
81d647fcf45a.zh: 为什么？在 y 撇等于 λy 上测试每一种方法，令 z 等于 h 乘以 λ：每一步都把 y 乘以某个 R(z)。<bookmark mark='a'/>欧拉法的因子是1加 z：只在以负1为圆心的一个圆盘内稳定。<bookmark mark='b'/>四阶 Runge–Kutta 的因子是它的泰勒多项式：区域更大，但仍然有界。<bookmark mark='c'/>向后欧拉法取新点处的斜率，得到的是1减 z 分之一，<bookmark mark='d'/>它在整个左半平面上都小于1。Germund Dahlquist 在1963年把这称为 A 稳定性。显式方法的因子是一个多项式，是无界的，所以没有任何显式方法是 A 稳定的。

554e3fcdbb04.en: Some problems care less about one moment than about what is conserved over millions of steps: planets, molecules, particle beams. <bookmark mark='a'/> Leapfrog, which Loup Verlet used for molecules in 1967, gives the momentum half a kick, lets the position drift a full step, then finishes the kick. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each part is a shear of phase space, which keeps areas exactly: the step is symplectic. <bookmark mark='c'/> We ran an orbit of eccentricity one half for a thousand revolutions, a hundred steps each. <bookmark mark='d'/> Runge–Kutta four's orbit has shrunk. Leapfrog's has the right size, but has turned.
554e3fcdbb04.zh: 有些问题关心的不是某一时刻，而是在几百万步中守恒的东西：行星、分子、粒子束。<bookmark mark='a'/>蛙跳法，Loup Verlet 在1967年把它用于分子，先给动量半次冲击，让位置漂移整整一步，再完成那次冲击。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一部分都是相空间的一次剪切，它精确地保持面积：这一步是辛的。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们让一个偏心率为二分之一的轨道运行了一千圈，每圈一百步。<bookmark mark='d'/>四阶 Runge–Kutta 的轨道缩小了。蛙跳法的轨道大小正确，但转了一个角度。

d33ad30be40b.en: Here is the energy after every orbit. <bookmark mark='a'/> Runge–Kutta four starts out more accurate, but its error grows steadily, to three percent after a thousand orbits. <bookmark mark='b'/> Leapfrog's is about one percent, and never grows. <bookmark mark='c'/> After about three hundred and seventy orbits leapfrog is ahead, and the gap only widens. <bookmark mark='d'/> The reason is a theorem: a symplectic method almost exactly conserves a slightly different energy, a modified Hamiltonian, so the true energy can only wobble around it. <bookmark mark='e'/> It is chapter two's backward error analysis again: the method solves a nearby problem, nearly exactly.
d33ad30be40b.zh: 这是每一圈之后的能量。<bookmark mark='a'/>四阶 Runge–Kutta 一开始更精确，但它的误差稳步增长，一千圈后达到百分之三。<bookmark mark='b'/>蛙跳法的误差大约是百分之一，而且从不增长。<bookmark mark='c'/>大约370圈之后，蛙跳法领先，而且差距只会越来越大。<bookmark mark='d'/>原因是一条定理：辛方法几乎精确地守恒一个稍有不同的能量，也就是修正哈密顿量，所以真正的能量只能围绕它摆动。<bookmark mark='e'/>这又是第二章的向后误差分析：方法几乎精确地求解了一个邻近的问题。

7f786d0da994.en: Chapter fourteen. Speed: BLAS, LAPACK, and mixed precision.
7f786d0da994.zh: 第十四章：速度：BLAS、LAPACK 与混合精度。

2139114bf40a.en: Almost every algorithm in this part spends its time in a few kernels, standardized as the Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms, the BLAS. <bookmark mark='a'/> Level one, from 1979, works on vectors: a times x plus y does two operations per element and moves twenty-four bytes, one twelfth of an operation per byte. <bookmark mark='b'/> Level two, from 1988, multiplies a matrix by a vector, and uses each matrix entry once: a quarter per byte. <bookmark mark='c'/> Level three, from 1990, multiplies matrices: two n cubed operations on three n squared numbers, an intensity of n over twelve, growing with n. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is Part 9's roofline in one line: only level three does enough arithmetic per byte to keep a processor busy.
2139114bf40a.zh: 这一部分里几乎每一个算法，都把时间花在少数几个内核上，它们被标准化为基本线性代数子程序，也就是 BLAS。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一级来自1979年，作用于向量：a 乘 x 加 y，每个元素做两次运算，搬动24个字节，也就是每字节十二分之一次运算。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二级来自1988年，做矩阵乘以向量，每个矩阵元素只用一次：每字节四分之一次。<bookmark mark='c'/>第三级来自1990年，做矩阵乘矩阵：对3n 平方个数做2n 立方次运算，强度是 n 除以12，随 n 增长。<bookmark mark='d'/>这就是一行字写下的第9部分的屋顶线模型：只有第三级在每个字节上做了足够多的算术，能让处理器一直忙碌。

11f8eb70f411.en: Here are the three levels timed on this machine, through NumPy, which calls an optimized BLAS. <bookmark mark='a'/> Matrix multiplication climbs as n grows, to about 289 billion operations per second at two thousand and forty-eight. <bookmark mark='b'/> The other two, at that size, manage 0.7 and 27 billion: 408 and 11 times slower, doing the same kind of arithmetic. <bookmark mark='c'/> Small vector additions fit in cache and run faster than large ones, which is Part 9's memory hierarchy, not arithmetic. <bookmark mark='d'/> So the craft of numerical linear algebra since 1990 has been to recast every algorithm so that most of its work is level three.
11f8eb70f411.zh: 这是三个级别在这台机器上的计时，通过 NumPy，它调用的是一个优化过的 BLAS。<bookmark mark='a'/>矩阵乘法随着 n 增大而攀升，在2048阶时达到大约每秒289吉次运算。<bookmark mark='b'/>另外两个在这个规模上，只能达到每秒0.7吉次和27吉次：做的是同一类算术，却慢了408倍和11倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>小的向量加法能放进缓存，比大的跑得更快，这是第9部分的存储层次，而不是算术。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以，1990年以来，数值线性代数的手艺就是改写每一个算法，让它的大部分工作都落在第三级上。

b074453c60e1.en: LAPACK, released in 1992, does exactly that. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take chapter three's elimination, but instead of one column at a time, factor a narrow panel of b columns, <bookmark mark='b'/> then update everything to its lower right at once: the trailing matrix minus a product of two thin blocks, a matrix multiplication. <bookmark mark='c'/> Move to the next panel. Only the panels run at level two, about n squared b over two operations out of two thirds n cubed, <bookmark mark='d'/> a fraction of three b over four n. For ten thousand unknowns and panels of sixty-four, half of one percent. When NumPy solves a linear system, it calls exactly this routine.
b074453c60e1.zh: 1992年发布的 LAPACK 做的正是这件事。<bookmark mark='a'/>拿来第三章的消去法，但不再一次处理一列，而是分解一个由 b 列组成的窄面板，<bookmark mark='b'/>然后一次性更新它右下方的全部内容：尾随矩阵减去两个瘦块的乘积，也就是一次矩阵乘法。<bookmark mark='c'/>移到下一个面板。只有面板在第二级上运行，在三分之二 n 立方次运算中，大约占 n 平方乘 b 除以2次，<bookmark mark='d'/>比例是4n 分之3b。对一万个未知数、宽度64的面板，是百分之零点五。NumPy 求解线性方程组时，调用的正是这个例程。

ff1943672287.en: Speed also comes from fewer bits: single precision moves half the bytes, and usually runs at least twice as fast. <bookmark mark='a'/> So factor the matrix once in single precision: that is the n cubed work. <bookmark mark='b'/> Compute the residual in double, which costs only n squared, <bookmark mark='c'/> solve for a correction with the cheap factors, and add it. <bookmark mark='d'/> Each round multiplies the error by about kappa times single precision's rounding unit, so it converges when that product is below one. <bookmark mark='e'/> With kappa ten to the five, our instrument gains nearly three digits a round, and after four rounds is about as accurate as a full double-precision solve. Chapter fifteen goes down to sixteen bits.
ff1943672287.zh: 速度也来自更少的位数：单精度搬动的字节数减半，通常至少快一倍。<bookmark mark='a'/>所以用单精度把矩阵分解一次：这是 n 立方的工作量。<bookmark mark='b'/>用双精度计算残差，它只花 n 的平方，<bookmark mark='c'/>用便宜的因子解出一个修正量，把它加上去。<bookmark mark='d'/>每一轮都把误差乘以大约 κ 乘以单精度的单位舍入误差，所以当这个乘积小于1时，它就收敛。<bookmark mark='e'/>当 κ 为10的5次方时，我们的仪器每一轮获得将近三位数字，四轮之后，就和一次完整的双精度求解差不多一样精确。第十五章会一直降到16位。

fc71b8e47969.en: Since 1993 the world's fastest computers have been ranked twice a year, in the Top500 list, by one program: High-Performance Linpack, descended from the LINPACK library that Jack Dongarra co-wrote in 1979. <bookmark mark='a'/> It solves a dense random system by elimination with partial pivoting, and divides two thirds n cubed operations by the time. Almost all of it is matrix multiplication, so it measures a machine at its best. <bookmark mark='b'/> On this scale, our machine's level-one speed sits here, and its matrix multiplication here. <bookmark mark='c'/> In June 2022 Frontier, at Oak Ridge, became the first to pass ten to the eighteen operations per second: about 4 million times our matrix multiplication. <bookmark mark='d'/> A conjugate-gradient benchmark, sparse and memory-bound like most real simulations, reaches only a few percent of the same machines' peak.
fc71b8e47969.zh: 自1993年起，世界上最快的计算机每年排名两次，登上 Top500 榜单，所用的是一个程序：High-Performance Linpack，它源自 Jack Dongarra 在1979年参与编写的 LINPACK 库。<bookmark mark='a'/>它用部分选主元的消去法求解一个稠密的随机方程组，再把三分之二 n 立方次运算除以所用的时间。其中几乎全部是矩阵乘法，所以它衡量的是一台机器的最佳状态。<bookmark mark='b'/>在这个刻度上，我们机器的第一级速度在这里，它的矩阵乘法在这里。<bookmark mark='c'/>2022年6月，橡树岭的 Frontier 成为第一台每秒运算超过10的18次方次的计算机：大约是我们矩阵乘法的4百万倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个共轭梯度基准测试，像大多数真实的模拟一样稀疏、受内存限制，在同样的机器上只能达到峰值的百分之几。

d7ef7b1fc5c8.en: Chapter fifteen, the frontier. Can randomness, and fewer bits, make linear algebra faster and still right?
d7ef7b1fc5c8.zh: 第十五章，前沿。随机性和更少的位数，能不能让线性代数更快，同时依然正确？

008b9302534a.en: The first frontier is randomness. <bookmark mark='a'/> To approximate a large matrix by one of rank 20, multiply it by a thin random matrix. The product's columns are random mixtures of the matrix's own columns, and with high probability they span almost exactly its most important directions. <bookmark mark='b'/> Orthonormalize them, project, and take the SVD of a small matrix. Nathan Halko, Per-Gunnar Martinsson and Joel Tropp analysed this in 2011. <bookmark mark='c'/> On our 1,200 by 600 matrix, a few extra random columns and one or two power steps bring the error to within 1 percent of the best any rank-20 matrix can do, in a fraction of the 69.1 seconds a full SVD takes.
008b9302534a.zh: 第一个前沿是随机性。<bookmark mark='a'/>要用一个秩为20的矩阵来近似一个大矩阵，就把它乘以一个瘦长的随机矩阵。乘积的各列是这个矩阵自身各列的随机混合，它们以很高的概率几乎恰好张成它最重要的那些方向。<bookmark mark='b'/>把它们标准正交化，做投影，再对一个小矩阵做 SVD。Nathan Halko、Per-Gunnar Martinsson 和 Joel Tropp 在2011年分析了这个方法。<bookmark mark='c'/>在我们那个1200乘600的矩阵上，多加几个随机列，再做一两次幂迭代，误差就能达到任何秩20矩阵所能做到的最好结果的百分之1以内，所用的时间只是完整 SVD 所需69.1秒的一小部分。

7caacf8a30e2.en: The second frontier is precision. Graphics processors do arithmetic in sixteen bits many times faster than in sixty-four, because machine learning wants them to. Can numerical linear algebra use those bits without losing accuracy? <bookmark mark='a'/> Iterative refinement, an idea of Wilkinson's, says yes, sometimes. Factor the matrix cheaply in low precision, compute the residual in high precision, and solve for a correction using the cheap factors. <bookmark mark='b'/> For a well-conditioned matrix the error falls to double precision in two or three steps. <bookmark mark='c'/> For condition number ten to the eight, times single precision's epsilon of about ten to the minus seven, the product exceeds one, and refinement diverges. Since 2019 a benchmark built on this idea runs beside the classic Linpack ranking of supercomputers.
