7caacf8a30e2.zh: 第二个前沿是精度。图形处理器用16位做算术，比用64位快很多倍，因为机器学习需要它们这样。数值线性代数能不能利用这些位数，而不损失精度？<bookmark mark='a'/>迭代改进，这是威尔金森的一个想法，它的回答是：能，有时候能。用低精度便宜地分解矩阵，用高精度计算残差，再用便宜的因子解出一个修正量。<bookmark mark='b'/>对一个良态矩阵，误差在两三步内就降到双精度的水平。<bookmark mark='c'/>当条件数为10的8次方时，乘以单精度大约10的负7次方的机器精度，乘积超过了1，迭代改进就发散了。自2019年起，一个基于这个想法的基准测试，与经典的 Linpack 超级计算机排名并列发布。

51efc5c792da.en: The third frontier is a theorem we do not have. Partial pivoting can grow entries by two to the n minus one, so in the worst case elimination is unstable, yet in practice it never is. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take Wilkinson's worst-case matrix and add noise of one part in a hundred million. The growth falls from two billion to two. The worst case needs exact ties in every column, and any perturbation breaks them. <bookmark mark='b'/> Daniel Spielman and Shang-Hua Teng invented smoothed analysis to explain why the simplex method is fast in practice: the worst case is surrounded by easy cases. For elimination with partial pivoting, the analogous theorem, polynomial growth under small random perturbations, has not been proved.
51efc5c792da.zh: 第三个前沿是一条我们还没有的定理。部分选主元可能让元素增长到2的 n 减1次方倍，所以在最坏情况下，消去法是不稳定的，然而在实践中，它从来不会这样。<bookmark mark='a'/>拿来威尔金森的最坏情况矩阵，加上一亿分之一的噪声。增长就从20亿降到了2。最坏情况需要每一列都恰好打平，而任何扰动都会打破它们。<bookmark mark='b'/>Daniel Spielman 和滕尚华发明了平滑分析，来解释为什么单纯形法在实践中很快：最坏情况被容易的情况包围着。对部分选主元的消去法，类似的定理，也就是在小的随机扰动下增长是多项式的，还没有被证明。

2e1b156d1b78.en: Open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> Whether matrices can be multiplied in time close to n squared, the question from Part 19. <bookmark mark='b'/> Whether linear systems can be solved that fast and still stably, in practice and not only in theory. <bookmark mark='c'/> Which algorithms survive sixteen-bit arithmetic, and with what corrections. <bookmark mark='d'/> And algorithms whose cost in moving data, which now dominates, meets its lower bound. <bookmark mark='e'/> This part's research problem is the missing theorem: prove that elimination with partial pivoting has polynomially bounded growth, with high probability, on any matrix perturbed by a little Gaussian noise.
2e1b156d1b78.zh: 未解问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>矩阵乘法能否在接近 n 平方的时间内完成，这是第19部分提出的问题。<bookmark mark='b'/>线性方程组能否也这么快地求解，同时依然稳定，在实践中而不只是在理论上。<bookmark mark='c'/>哪些算法能在16位算术中幸存下来，又需要什么样的修正。<bookmark mark='d'/>还有那些搬动数据的代价，如今已占主导，达到其下界的算法。<bookmark mark='e'/>这一部分的研究题就是那条缺失的定理：证明对任何加上一点高斯噪声扰动的矩阵，部分选主元的消去法以很高的概率具有多项式有界的增长。

95bbc30c7d89.en: What we built in this part. The condition number, which says how hard a problem is, separate from backward stability, which says how good an algorithm is, and the rule that joins them: forward error is at most the condition number times the backward error. Elimination made stable by pivoting; Householder's mirrors and the SVD; the QR algorithm, converging cubically; conjugate gradients, multigrid and sparse orderings for systems with millions of unknowns; Newton's method and its fractal; Chebyshev points, Gauss quadrature, stiff solvers and symplectic integrators. One idea runs through it: with rounding everywhere, the right question is not whether an answer is exact, but whether it is the exact answer to a nearby problem.
95bbc30c7d89.zh: 这一部分我们搭建了什么。条件数，它说明一个问题有多难，与向后稳定性分开，后者说明一个算法有多好，以及把两者连起来的规则：向前误差至多是条件数乘以向后误差。靠选主元变得稳定的消去法；Householder 的镜子和 SVD；三次收敛的 QR 算法；用于有几百万个未知数的方程组的共轭梯度法、多重网格和稀疏排序；牛顿法和它的分形；切比雪夫点、高斯求积、刚性求解器和辛积分器。一个思想贯穿其中：既然舍入无处不在，正确的问题就不是一个答案是否精确，而是它是不是一个邻近问题的精确答案。

57b40500adf5.en: Where this comes back. Part 51's renderer is linear algebra and integration, done billions of times a second. Part 53's quantum computer is a unitary matrix acting on a vector. Part 54 proves programs correct, floating point included. Part 56 reads a graph through the eigenvalues of its matrix. And Part 57's learning theory rests on the same optimization.
57b40500adf5.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再出现。第51部分的渲染器就是线性代数和积分，每秒做几十亿次。第53部分的量子计算机，是一个作用在向量上的酉矩阵。第54部分证明程序是正确的，浮点数也包括在内。第56部分通过一个图的矩阵的特征值来解读这个图。而第57部分的学习理论，依赖的是同样的优化。

90c90728c840.en: In practice. Never invert a matrix to solve a system: factor it, with pivoting. Fit least squares with QR or the SVD, not the normal equations. Estimate the condition number and report residuals, not only answers. Use sparse and iterative methods, with a good preconditioner, for big systems. And call BLAS and LAPACK: write your own matrix multiplication only to learn how it works.
90c90728c840.zh: 实践中。永远不要为了求解方程组而对矩阵求逆：要分解它，并且选主元。用 QR 或 SVD 做最小二乘拟合，而不是用正规方程。估计条件数，并报告残差，而不只是答案。对大型方程组，使用稀疏方法和迭代方法，配上一个好的预条件子。还有，调用 BLAS 和 LAPACK：只有在想学习它的原理时，才自己写矩阵乘法。

379c3d27c0f4.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: a two-grid solver for the one-dimensional Poisson problem, whose convergence factor should not depend on the size of the grid. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: prove that partial pivoting's growth is polynomial once the matrix is perturbed by a little noise.
379c3d27c0f4.zh: 六道习题，完整解答在这一部分的笔记里。可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是构建题：为一维泊松问题写一个两重网格求解器，它的收敛因子不应依赖于网格的大小。最后一道标有星号，是研究题：证明只要矩阵受到一点噪声的扰动，部分选主元的增长就是多项式的。

43617e9e2b52.en: Next time, Part 53: quantum computation. A qubit is a unit vector in a two-dimensional complex space, a gate is a unitary matrix, and a computation is a product of them, linear algebra again. Interference makes wrong answers cancel, and one algorithm built on it, Shor's, would end the public-key cryptography of Part 30.
43617e9e2b52.zh: 下一次，第53部分：量子计算。一个量子比特是二维复空间中的一个单位向量，一个门是一个酉矩阵，而一次计算就是它们的乘积，又是线性代数。干涉让错误的答案相互抵消，而建立在它之上的一个算法，Shor 算法，将终结第30部分的公钥密码学。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分所依据的书和论文都在屏幕上和笔记里。感谢观看。
